title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
summary: With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.
translation:
标题：OmniCompass：面向全模态视频定位与理解的综合性基准

摘要：随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的快速发展，评估其视频理解能力变得日益重要。现有视频理解基准仅覆盖部分评估维度，限制了对全模态视频理解的系统性诊断。我们提出 OmniCompass，一个面向全模态视频定位与理解的综合性基准。OmniCompass 定义了两个评估轨道：OmniCompass-VL 在需要视觉证据的任务上评估视觉语言模型，而 OmniCompass-AV 在需要音视频联合证据的任务上评估全模态模型。每个轨道包含三项互补任务：时间定位（TG）、空间定位（SG）和问答（QA），分别评估被引用目标何时出现、位于何处以及发生了什么。QA 在 OmniCompass-VL 中涵盖 5 个感知类别和 3 个推理类别，在 OmniCompass-AV 中涵盖 3 个感知类别和 2 个推理类别。OmniCompass-VL 包含 820 个视频和 2,460 个实例，覆盖多个领域以及短、中、长三种时长类型。一个富含叙事与音频的子集构成 OmniCompass-AV，包含 240 个视频和 720 个实例。每个实例均在两种成对设置下进行评估：纯文本与文本+图像，二者通过文本以及视觉-语言引导指定同一目标。所有实例均经人工标注，并经过多轮质量验证。对 50 个 MLLM 的评估表明，开源模型仍落后于专有同类模型，尤其是在音视频理解方面。即使对领先模型而言，精确的时间与空间定位仍具挑战性，且其预测在成对目标指定之间仍表现出不一致性。

title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
summary: Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--student settings, Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest domain-average score among the compared distillation methods. Ablations with the Qwen3-8B student show that removing or shuffling gates reduces mathematical reasoning performance. These results support the use of directional agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts to weight the endpoint shift during student training.
translation:
标题：Waypoint-OPD：通过门控同策略蒸馏迁移强化学习引发的策略偏移

摘要：策略偏移蒸馏复用教师在强化学习（RL）前后对数概率之间的差异，作为对学生生成轨迹的监督信号。然而，这种端点策略偏移无法揭示教师训练过程中局部动作偏好是否一致演化。相同的端点偏移可能源于早期与晚期偏移相互增强或部分抵消。我们考察早期与晚期教师策略偏移之间的一致性是否能够指导选择性迁移。我们提出路径点引导的同策略蒸馏（Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation, Waypoint-OPD），该方法利用同一RL运行中的中间教师检查点，在学生访问过的前缀处比较相对动作偏好的早期与晚期偏移。我们根据早期与晚期偏移之间的方向一致性对端点偏移进行门控，当二者方向相反时抑制该端点偏移。与仅端点迁移相比，我们的方法仅需额外进行一次冻结教师评分过程。我们使用经RL训练的Qwen3-4B教师，在数学与代码推理任务中，以Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B和Qwen3-30B-A3B作为学生模型评估我们的方法。在所有六个领域—学生设定中，Waypoint-OPD在参与比较的蒸馏方法中取得了最高的领域平均得分。在Qwen3-8B学生上的消融实验表明，移除或打乱门控会降低数学推理性能。这些结果支持利用早期与晚期教师策略偏移之间的方向一致性，在学生训练期间对端点偏移进行加权。

title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
summary: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.
translation:
标题：自演化智能体运行框架

摘要：运行框架自演化会修改智能体的软件脚手架，包括提示词、记忆、工作流和可执行组件，同时保持模型权重固定。我们形式化了一种反馈驱动过程，其中被接受的修订会跨运行持久保留。该框架将更新目标与提案机制和准入机制分离，并区分解释性状态的变更与对工具和代码、仓库级控制逻辑及插件组合的修订。我们通过演化优化刻画搜索，并通过持续 PAC 学习考察其可靠性。在明确假设下，该分析给出了期望泛化界、以历史回归预算为条件的保留界，以及使用全新且独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。我们考察持久的运行框架修订如何影响知识共享与组织工作流，并探讨其对科学可靠性、物理安全与制度问责的启示。先前工作的案例展示了模型—运行框架协同设计、分布式执行与插件复用。可靠部署需要在任务分布和评估器变化时持续验证，并为学习、运行时权限和具有重大后果的行动提供独立保障。我们提供了一份全面的 66 页讨论，涵盖相关工作、理论、算法、评估、应用以及 Harness RSI 的更广泛影响，并附持续更新的代码与补充材料，见 https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI。

title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
summary: Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. Our automated pipeline constructs silhouette-preserving 3D objects from 2D icons and uses reversible initialization to guarantee solvability, yielding 674 tasks and a stratified 100-task test set. Empirically, we find that (i) a substantial human-model gap persists: GPT-5.6-Sol succeeds on only 17% of tasks, whereas 20 undergraduate participants collectively complete the test set four times with a 100% success rate; (ii) image-space and pose-space progress can diverge: at matched states, the model more often improves silhouette overlap while worsening pose alignment than humans (19.4% vs. 10.9%); and (iii) fine-grained control is sensitive to interaction history: removing it leaves 96.8% of the model's actions at a coarse 30-degree step size and sharply reduces observed task success. These findings highlight the challenge of converting visual evidence into precise 3D control, beyond recognizing or matching individual images.
translation:
标题：RoTA-Bench：通过交互式投影对齐评估三维空间推理

摘要：视觉语言模型能否将二维观测转化为支持精确动作的三维理解？这要求推断物体几何、预判旋转的影响，并通过视觉反馈优化动作。我们提出 RoTA-Bench，通过交互式三维到二维投影对齐来评估这些能力。给定一个目标轮廓，模型观察一个经旋转的物体，并在有限动作预算内选择连续旋转以恢复目标投影。我们的自动化流程从二维图标构建保持轮廓的三维物体，并采用可逆初始化来保证可解性，最终生成 674 个任务和一个分层的 100 任务测试集。实证上，我们发现：(i) 显著的人-模型差距依然存在：GPT-5.6-Sol 仅在 17% 的任务上成功，而 20 名本科生参与者以 100% 的成功率共同完成了该测试集四次；(ii) 图像空间与姿态空间的进展可能发生偏离：在匹配状态下，相比人类，模型更常出现轮廓重叠改善而姿态对齐恶化的情况（19.4% 对 10.9%）；以及 (iii) 细粒度控制对交互历史敏感：移除交互历史会使模型 96.8% 的动作停留在粗略的 30 度步长，并大幅降低观察到的任务成功率。这些发现凸显了将视觉证据转化为精确三维控制的挑战，其难度超越了识别或匹配单个图像。

title: Learning Where to Split: Dynamic Band Splitting for Audio Source Separation
summary: Audio source separation models must preserve fine spectral structure while keeping the cost of the separator tractable. Band-split architectures reduce this cost by manually partitioning the spectrum into predefined frequency bands and encoding each band as a token, but the same boundaries are used for every mixture. Because informative spectral structure varies with source content, fixed boundaries can merge discriminative components or spend tokens where little resolution is needed. We introduce Dynamic Band Splitting (DBS), an end-to-end framework that adapts boundary locations and band widths to each mixture under a fixed band-token budget. DBS predicts content-conditioned boundary scores within frequency blocks, selects a prescribed number of boundaries using hard Top-K, and applies content-dependent pooling to obtain compact band tokens. After separation, it smooths and expands these tokens to the original STFT grid, refines them along frequency, and decodes complex masks with a frequency-shared head. DBS improved separation over the corresponding static models on DnR v2, MUSDB18-HQ, and EchoSet, with DBS-BSRNN achieving relative gain of 29.0% in average SI-SDR on DnR v2. These results and boundary analyses on DnR v2 show that content-adaptive frequency partitioning benefits multiple separator backbones under a fixed band-token budget. Code and audio demos are available at https://cslikai.cn/Dynamic-Band-Splitting
translation:
标题：学习分割位置：面向音频源分离的动态频带分割
摘要：音频源分离模型必须在保持分离器成本可控的同时，保留精细的频谱结构。频带分割架构通过人工将频谱划分为预定义频带，并将每个频带编码为一个 token，从而降低该成本，但所有混合信号都使用相同边界。由于有信息量的频谱结构随源内容而变化，固定边界可能会合并具有判别性的成分，或在几乎不需要分辨率的位置耗费 token。我们提出动态频带分割（DBS），这是一个端到端框架，能够在固定频带 token 预算下，针对每个混合信号自适应调整边界位置和频带宽度。DBS 在频率块内预测内容条件化的边界分数，使用硬 Top-K 选择规定数量的边界，并应用内容相关的池化以获得紧凑的频带 token。在分离之后，它将这些 token 平滑并扩展至原始 STFT 网格，沿频率方向对其进行细化，并使用频率共享头解码复数掩码。DBS 在 DnR v2、MUSDB18-HQ 和 EchoSet 上相比对应的静态模型提升了分离性能，其中 DBS-BSRNN 在 DnR v2 上的平均 SI-SDR 相对增益达到 29.0%。这些结果以及 DnR v2 上的边界分析表明，在固定频带 token 预算下，内容自适应的频率划分可使多种分离器骨干受益。代码和音频演示可在 https://cslikai.cn/Dynamic-Band-Splitting 获取。

title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views
summary: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/
translation:
标题：InfiniSplat v2：从任意视角分析与改进前馈式3DGS

摘要：前馈式高斯重建可直接从输入图像构建三维场景，以用于新视角渲染，但基于预测几何学习高斯属性，从而在大视角变化下实现高质量渲染，仍然具有挑战性。我们分析了高斯属性学习中的局限性，并提出 InfiniSplat v2，通过架构和训练方面的改进提升渲染质量。我们的方法利用冻结的几何分支解耦几何与属性预测，在训练期间使用真值相机位姿对齐预测高斯，并采用大角度目标视角监督。在六个数据集上，同一训练模型的前馈输出在位姿条件与无位姿设定下，其平均 LPIPS 和 DISTS 均在所评估方法中达到最优。在位姿条件设定下，与最强的评估基线相比，平均 LPIPS 和 DISTS 分别降低 25.8% 和 32.9%。我们进一步发现，仅在图像重建监督下学习的不透明度会抑制几何不一致的点。项目主页：https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/

title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
summary: Computer use has reached a turning point: the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to systems that complete tasks on users' computers through visual and programmatic interfaces. We define a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) as a system in which the model chooses how to observe, act, and organize its work across visual and programmatic interfaces. Yet frontier implementations, such as GPT-6 Astra's computer-use system, remain largely closed, limiting systematic study of their design. We introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community. This report presents the first release of OpenGCUA. Code execution is a key feature of our agent design: it lets intermediate results determine subsequent operations and enables models to apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction. We also propose harness-to-model decision transfer, moving selected observations and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK. The harness addresses real-device challenges not fully captured by benchmarks, while the SDK provides a common programming interface across computers, mobiles and browsers. Across four real macOS tasks under our real-device harness, selected Qwen3.8-Max runs use 19.4 times as many reported reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra, highlighting substantial differences between models in real-device execution efficiency.
translation:
标题：OpenGCUA：迈向通用型计算机使用的完全开放技术栈  
摘要：计算机使用已到达一个转折点：关注点正从仅限 GUI 的交互，扩展到通过视觉与程序化接口在用户计算机上完成任务的系统。我们将通用型计算机使用智能体（GCUA）定义为一个系统，其中模型选择如何跨视觉与程序化接口进行观察、行动并组织其工作。然而，前沿实现（如 GPT-6 Astra 的计算机使用系统）仍大体保持封闭，限制了对这些设计的系统性研究。我们提出 Open Generalist CUA（OpenGCUA），这是一个持续进行的项目，旨在与社区共同开发和开放 GCUA 的完整技术栈。本报告介绍 OpenGCUA 的首个版本。代码执行是我们智能体设计的一个关键特性：它使中间结果能够决定后续操作，并使模型能够将其已有的编程能力直接应用于计算机交互。我们还提出从执行框架到模型的决策迁移（harness-to-model decision transfer），将选定的观察结果和任务状态决策从固定的执行框架规则转移到模型。在 OSWorld-v2 上，我们的完整配置提升了所有八个被评估模型的任务得分，包括 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5；相对于批量化的仅 GUI 执行，使平均部分得分提高了 19.6 分，并使每任务报告步骤数平均减少 53.0%。我们发布了实现与提示词、来自所有八个模型的评估轨迹，以及真实设备执行框架和跨设备 SDK 的初步版本。该执行框架解决了基准测试未能完全覆盖的真实设备挑战，而 SDK 提供了跨计算机、移动设备和浏览器的通用编程接口。在我们的真实设备执行框架下，针对四个真实 macOS 任务，选定的 Qwen3.8-Max 运行所报告的推理 token 数是 GPT-6 Astra 的 19.4 倍，凸显了不同模型在真实设备执行效率上的显著差异。

title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
summary: Spatial intelligence lets an agent perceive and act in the physical world, and many of its judgments must be made at interaction rates: which spatial relation holds, how far an object is, or where to place it. Vision-language models (VLMs) produce these answers by free-form text generation, paying for autoregressive decoding and answer parsing even though the output space is compact: one of a few options, a scalar, or a 2D point. In light of this, we introduce MJev-Spatial, a System 1 multimodal decision model that tackles all three types of spatial understanding tasks within a unified classification framework. Specifically, MJev-Spatial treats each candidate as a class and scores it using the backbone's pretrained query and key projections, without adding parameters. The candidates are the given options for choice tasks, or value bins and image regions refined through coarse-to-fine classification for numerical and point prediction, respectively. At inference, each classification decision takes a single forward pass and generates no answer tokens. To train on heterogeneous spatial data efficiently, we supervise all coarse-to-fine stages jointly with teacher forcing in one forward pass, and combine this with length-aware global batching and cross-GPU load balancing, raising training throughput by 30.8% over the original batching strategy. Built on Qwen3.5-4B and trained on 12.3M question-answer pairs converted from existing spatial datasets, MJev-Spatial achieves the highest overall score (65.64%) among eight tested models, ranks first on seven of twelve benchmarks, and outperforms its unmodified autoregressive base model on all twelve, while running 2.5 times faster than the fastest autoregressive baseline and 5.6 times faster than the base model.
translation:
标题：MJev-Spatial：通过原生注意力匹配实现系统1空间智能

摘要：空间智能使智能体能够感知物理世界并采取行动，其许多判断必须在交互速率下做出：哪种空间关系成立、物体距离多远，或应将其放置在何处。视觉语言模型（VLM）通过自由形式的文本生成来产生这些答案，即便输出空间是紧凑的——少量选项之一、一个标量或一个二维点——仍需付出自回归解码和答案解析的代价。有鉴于此，我们提出 MJev-Spatial，一种系统1多模态决策模型，在统一的分类框架内处理所有三类空间理解任务。具体而言，MJev-Spatial 将每个候选视为一个类别，并使用主干网络预训练的查询和键投影为其评分，而无需增加参数。对于选择任务，候选是给定选项；对于数值预测和点预测，候选分别是数值分箱和图像区域，并通过由粗到细分类进行细化。推理时，每个分类决策仅需一次前向传播，且不生成答案 token。为高效训练异构空间数据，我们在一次前向传播中通过教师强制联合监督所有由粗到细阶段，并将其与长度感知的全局批处理和跨 GPU 负载均衡相结合，使训练吞吐量较原始批处理策略提升 30.8%。MJev-Spatial 基于 Qwen3.5-4B 构建，并在从现有空间数据集转换而来的 1230 万问答对上训练，在八个测试模型中取得最高总体得分（65.64%），在十二个基准测试中的七个上排名第一，并在全部十二个基准上优于其未修改的自回归基础模型，同时运行速度比最快的自回归基线快 2.5 倍，比基础模型快 5.6 倍。

title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
summary: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second, we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. It uses execution checks, spatial measurements, and visual feedback to automatically evaluate and revise generated programs without human feedback during generation. Third, we conduct systematic empirical studies of 3D coding, establishing baselines with fine-tuned open models and deriving practical guidance through component-level analyses of our harness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning on our dataset significantly improves the 3D coding capabilities of open-source models. Notably, our 3DCodeVerse harness achieves a 90% win rate against Claude Design (3D Object) in pairwise human evaluations, when both are utilized by Claude Opus 5.5.
translation:
标题：3DCodeVerse：将3D世界作为代码探索

摘要：我们介绍了3DCodeVerse，一个研究生态系统，使编程智能体能够大规模创建可编辑且可验证的3D内容。3DCodeVerse包含大规模高质量的3D可执行代码数据集、用于空间推理和自动验证的编程工具链，以及3D编程的实用指南。首先，我们构建了3DCodeVerse-2M，一个大规模精心策划的独立3D可执行代码数据集。我们通过收集开源数据、转换专用表示以及使用编程智能体生成新程序来构建此语料库。每个程序都打包有在其声明环境中执行所需的源文件和相关资产，以及可用的描述和验证记录。其次，我们开发了3DCodeVerse工具链，一个用于生成和优化3D内容的多智能体有向无环图框架。它使用执行检查、空间测量和视觉反馈来自动评估和修正生成的程序，生成过程中无需人工反馈。第三，我们对3D编程进行了系统的实证研究，建立了微调开源模型的基线，并通过工具链的组件级分析得出了实用指南。大量实验表明，在我们的数据集上进行微调显著提高了开源模型的3D编程能力。值得注意的是，当Claude Opus 5.5同时使用我们的3DCodeVerse工具链和Claude Design（3D对象）时，在成对人工评估中，我们的工具链对Claude Design（3D对象）取得了90%的胜率。

title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
summary: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.
translation:
标题：FDE-Gym：AI 交付的最后一公里

摘要：现有智能体基准通常评估智能体在由问题报告、规范说明或任务工单定义的明确任务上的表现。真实世界的客户交付则不同：前沿部署工程师（FDE）必须澄清模糊需求、在实时系统中工作，并发现未明说的约束条件。我们提出 FDE-Gym，一个包含来自 18 个行业、20 个客户场景的 95 个端到端交付任务的基准，每个任务均由行业专家从真实交付项目中改编而来。在具有脚本化利益相关方和可修改客户系统的模拟客户环境中，智能体与利益相关方交互，并在类生产系统上操作，以交付可用的解决方案。FDE-Gym 根据交付对客户自身成功指标的提升程度进行评分，并将其归一化到 0（系统未改变）至 1（参考解决方案）之间，同时对利益相关方交互（消息、试运行和等待时间）施加惩罚。一个在线平台使人类能够在相同评分标准下练习 FDE 技能。我们评估了来自七家提供商的 13 种模型配置。在必须发现未明说约束的现实设置中，最佳配置取得 0.56 的 FDE-Gym 平均分，并且仅解决了 95 个任务中的 14 个（得分至少 0.8 且无事故）。发现未明说的约束是主要瓶颈：当模型必须在没有明确指导的情况下揭示这些约束时，性能急剧下降。然而，仅靠信息发现并不能解释这一差距：即使在最佳配置从利益相关方获得所有关键事实的 23 个任务上，它也仅在 10 个任务上达到 0.8 或以上的归一化业务提升。这些结果表明，在解决明确规定的任务与为真实客户交付有效 AI 系统之间存在显著差距。

title: SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables language models to improve text-to-image (T2I) generation by rewriting prompts for a frozen image generator. Existing methods typically apply a single signal derived from the image to individual subword tokens, although objects, counts, attributes, and relations form coherent semantic spans. We propose SCOPE, an objective based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that aligns update weighting with this structure. The rewriter jointly generates an enhanced prompt and its semantic partition. SCOPE pools shifts in policy log probabilities within each span to derive a shared coefficient for its token losses while retaining a single advantage for each completion. It requires neither separate span rewards nor additional image renders. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves average relative gains over vanilla GRPO of 9.48% on GeneVal and 7.62% on T2I-CompBench. Ablation studies show that both semantic boundaries and pooling within spans contribute to these gains, supporting semantic structure as a practical inductive bias for prompt engineering with RL.
translation:
标题：SCOPE：面向文本到图像生成的提示工程语义边界信用优化

摘要：强化学习（RL）使语言模型能够通过为冻结的图像生成器重写提示来改进文本到图像（T2I）生成。现有方法通常将来自图像的单一信号应用于各个子词标记，尽管对象、数量、属性和关系构成了连贯的语义跨度。我们提出SCOPE，一种基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的目标函数，使更新权重与这一结构对齐。重写器联合生成增强提示及其语义划分。SCOPE在每个跨度内汇总策略对数概率的变化，为其标记损失推导共享系数，同时为每个补全保留单一优势。它既不需要单独的跨度奖励，也不需要额外的图像渲染。在Qwen-Image、SD3和FLUX.1-dev上，SCOPE相较于原始GRPO在GeneVal上实现了9.48%的平均相对增益，在T2I-CompBench上实现了7.62%的平均相对增益。消融研究表明，语义边界和跨度内汇总均对这些增益有所贡献，支持语义结构作为RL提示工程的一种实用归纳偏置。

title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Few-step autoregressive video generators enable streaming generation, yet they run every token through the final denoising step, regardless of how much refinement it needs. We find this uniform computation is often unnecessary: many tokens already closely match their eventual full-step outputs in the initial steps, while others require refinement until the end. We introduce Speculative Forcing, a framework that treats intermediate clean estimates as drafts and predicts when individual tokens can be safely accepted early. Once accepted, a token is frozen as its final output and undergoes no further denoising, while its cached keys and values remain available as context for the remaining tokens. We explore two alternative verifier designs: a training-free one based on similarity to clean content and stability across steps, and a learned one that reads the frozen generator's intermediate features to estimate each token's remaining gap to its full-step output. Across short-video, long-video, and world generation, Speculative Forcing preserves the quality of full-step sampling while substantially reducing computation. On LongLive, it matches the four-step generator with ~1.7 denoising steps per token, running over 1.5x faster at 41.7 and 37.8 fps. On Lingbot-World 2.0, where camera motion continually changes the visible content, it maintains quality with ~2.5 denoising steps per token and runs 1.35x faster at 24.5 fps.
translation:
标题：推测性强制：高效自回归视频生成

摘要：少步自回归视频生成器支持流式生成，但无论每个词元需要多少精炼，它们都会将每个词元送入最终去噪步骤。我们发现这种统一计算通常是不必要的：许多词元在初始步骤就已与其最终的全步输出非常接近，而另一些词元则需要一直精炼到最后。我们提出了推测性强制（Speculative Forcing），这是一个将中间干净估计视为草稿并预测单个词元何时可以被安全提前接受的框架。一旦被接受，词元就被冻结为其最终输出，不再进行进一步去噪，同时其缓存的键和值仍可作为剩余词元的上下文使用。我们探索了两种替代验证器设计：一种无需训练的验证器，基于与干净内容的相似性以及跨步骤的稳定性；另一种可学习的验证器，读取冻结生成器的中间特征来估计每个词元与全步输出之间的剩余差距。在短视频、长视频和世界生成任务中，推测性强制在保持全步采样质量的同时大幅减少了计算量。在LongLive上，它以每个词元约1.7个去噪步骤匹配四步生成器，以41.7和37.8 fps运行，速度提升超过1.5倍。在Lingbot-World 2.0上，相机运动持续改变可见内容，它以每个词元约2.5个去噪步骤保持质量，并以24.5 fps运行，速度提升1.35倍。

title: Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic, a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals into advantage estimation. At the session level, it shapes each session's advantage according to the estimated marginal contribution. Experiments on BrowseComp with Qwen3.5-4B show that Mosaic outperforms broadcasting in both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios while using fewer sessions on average. Further analyses show that our method achieves improvements in session utility and allocation, which we suggested is a promising target for future advances in multi-session agentic RL.
translation:
标题：Mosaic：多会话智能体强化学习

摘要：多数现有智能体强化学习方法假设单会话轨迹，即交互在一个持续累积的上下文中进行。然而，上下文压缩和子智能体分叉等智能体技术可能产生跨多个会话的轨迹，从而造成单会话训练假设与推理时执行之间的不匹配。因此，我们提出多会话智能体强化学习，这是一种更通用的设定，支持一条轨迹中包含任意数量的会话。在该设定下，一种广泛采用的方法是将轨迹级优势广播至所有会话，但这无法区分不同会话的贡献，也无法指导轨迹内的会话分配。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Mosaic，一种采用无评论家分层优化的多会话智能体强化学习方法。在轨迹层面，它将会话使用信号纳入优势估计；在会话层面，它根据估计的边际贡献塑造每个会话的优势。在 BrowseComp 上使用 Qwen3.5-4B 的实验表明，Mosaic 在上下文压缩和子智能体分叉两种场景下均优于广播方法，同时平均使用更少的会话。进一步分析表明，我们的方法在会话效用和分配方面取得了提升，我们认为这是多会话智能体强化学习未来进展的一个有前景的目标。

title: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
summary: Unified multimodal generation covers discrete, continuous, and hybrid paradigms. Discrete approaches with single-codebook visual tokenizers align naturally with text modeling but have limited representational capacity. Continuous and hybrid approaches retain richer visual representations, but they model text and images in heterogeneous spaces with different training objectives, potentially introducing optimization conflicts between modalities with misaligned representation spaces. These choices expose a central question: how to efficiently model high-capacity visual representations alongside textual content in a shared optimization space within a single backbone. We present Intern Lumina U2, to our knowledge the first diffusion language model to represent multi-codebook visual tokens in a fully discrete space. Each visual position is represented by a group of codes from complementary codebooks, increasing its representational capacity while preserving compatibility with discrete text modeling. At the input, the embeddings are concatenated at each position; at the output, a lightweight multi-codebook autoregressive head predicts the codes within each position sequentially, while the diffusion backbone processes all positions in parallel. Built on the unified 4D representation of AToken, Intern Lumina U2 supports image, video, and 3D inputs within a single backbone and achieves leading performance among unified models in visual understanding, image generation, and image editing. We further build a full-stack training, inference, and evaluation system on both Ascend and NVIDIA platforms to verify the cross-platform effectiveness of our model. We also improve the inference efficiency through a stability-aware sampling strategy, which combines confidence-plateau-guided unmasking approach with drift-triggered cache refreshing mechanisms, accelerating image generation by 4.45x.
translation:
标题：Intern Lumina U2：一种面向全视觉理解与图像生成的多码本扩散大语言模型

摘要：统一多模态生成涵盖离散、连续与混合范式。采用单码本视觉分词器的离散方法天然与文本建模对齐，但表示能力有限。连续与混合方法保留了更丰富的视觉表示，但它们在异质空间中以不同训练目标对文本和图像建模，可能因表示空间未对齐而引入模态间的优化冲突。这些选择揭示了一个核心问题：如何在单一骨干网络内的共享优化空间中，高效地将高容量视觉表示与文本内容一并建模。我们提出了 Intern Lumina U2，据我们所知，这是首个在完全离散空间中表示多码本视觉标记的扩散语言模型。每个视觉位置由来自互补码本的一组码表示，这提升了其表示能力，同时保持与离散文本建模的兼容性。在输入端，各位置的嵌入被拼接；在输出端，一个轻量级多码本自回归头顺序预测每个位置内的码，而扩散骨干并行处理所有位置。基于 AToken 的统一 4D 表示，Intern Lumina U2 在单一骨干网络中支持图像、视频和 3D 输入，并在视觉理解、图像生成和图像编辑方面取得统一模型中的领先性能。我们进一步在昇腾和 NVIDIA 平台上构建了全栈训练、推理与评估系统，以验证我们模型的跨平台有效性。我们还通过一种稳定性感知采样策略提升了推理效率，该策略将置信度平台引导的解掩码方法与漂移触发的缓存刷新机制相结合，将图像生成加速 4.45 倍。

title: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has driven rapid progress in mathematics, coding, and tool use, but scaling this success to GUI agents remains challenging due to the high cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic training tasks. We introduce MAI-Gym, an open all-in-one platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments. Through a shared rollout pipeline, MAI-Gym ensures consistent agent behavior across evaluation and training, supports ten established benchmarks, and scales to 20,000 parallel environment instances. Beyond scalable infrastructure, MAI-Gym enables automated synthesis of diverse GUI applications and challenging tasks, including resettable mocked apps and coherent cross-app worlds with execution-validated task verifiers. Using MAI-Gym, we train MAI-Gym-9B, a unified 9B agent for mobile and computer use, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open GUI agents under 10B parameters: 78.4% on MobileWorld and 76.2% on OSWorld-Verified. Importantly, RL in a mocked train-ticketing app transfers to its real-world counterpart, improving task success on a phys- ical phone from 28.8% to 48.1%. We release the framework, synthesis skills, mocked apps, 2,000 verified tasks, and the model checkpoint to support repro- ducible research and further advances in scalable GUI agent training.
translation:
标题：MAI-Gym：一个面向移动端与计算机环境的 GUI 智能体评估与强化学习训练开源一体化平台

摘要：具有可验证奖励的在线强化学习（RL）已推动数学、编程和工具使用领域的快速进展，但将这一成功扩展至 GUI 智能体仍具挑战，原因在于交互式环境成本高昂且真实训练任务稀缺。我们提出 MAI-Gym，一个开源一体化平台，统一了跨移动、计算机和 Web 环境的 GUI 智能体评估、数据收集与在线 RL 训练。通过共享的 rollout 流水线，MAI-Gym 确保智能体在评估与训练中的行为一致，支持十个成熟基准，并可扩展至 20,000 个并行环境实例。除可扩展基础设施外，MAI-Gym 还支持自动合成多样化的 GUI 应用与具有挑战性的任务，包括可重置的模拟应用，以及带有执行验证任务验证器的连贯跨应用世界。利用 MAI-Gym，我们训练了 MAI-Gym-9B，一个面向移动和计算机使用的统一 9B 智能体，在参数量低于 10B 的开源 GUI 智能体中达到最先进性能：MobileWorld 上 78.4%，OSWorld-Verified 上 76.2%。重要的是，在模拟火车票预订应用中进行的 RL 可迁移至其真实世界对应应用，使实体手机上的任务成功率从 28.8% 提升至 48.1%。我们发布该框架、合成技能、模拟应用、2,000 个已验证任务以及模型检查点，以支持可复现研究并推动可扩展 GUI 智能体训练的进一步发展。

title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce AutoSFT, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by +6.5, and synthesis adds +3.4 IFEval and +2.9 IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds +3.7 MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.
translation:
标题：AutoSFT：一种用于监督微调中自动化数据研究的智能体系统

摘要：语言模型智能体日益自动化训练后处理流程，但当被赋予完整训练栈时，它们往往会收敛于监督微调，并将大部分精力花在修改训练数据上。现有系统仅赋予智能体一种控制方式，即从固定数据池中选择样本或调用生成器，而人类数据工程师则会调整数据比例、修剪、修复、替换和合成数据。我们针对这些数据操作设计了一个数据动作空间，并探究自动化系统能否执行全部操作而非仅其中一种，以及这需要什么样的结构。我们首先用单一智能体运行这一循环，结果它仅能执行一种操作，即调整类别比例，同时其上下文被执行输出填满并在搜索中途被丢弃。因此，我们提出了AutoSFT，一种多智能体系统，其中元智能体将执行与分析分离，从独立角度收集提案，并调用合成子智能体以获取数据池无法覆盖的能力，同时在每次比较中固定模型、训练器和预算。逐一添加各组件均带来增益：执行器将上下文损失减半，分析子智能体将最佳IFEval提升+6.5，合成则额外增加+3.4 IFEval和+2.9 IFBench。同一循环可迁移至代码任务，其中分析在单智能体无法提升的情况下于MBPP+上增加+3.7。所有结果均来自每轮从基础模型重新训练的多次运行，因此每个组件的效果均可单独归因。我们的发现表明，自动化监督微调数据研究更多依赖于覆盖多样化的数据操作，而非强化单一操作。

title: DeltaStreamer: Towards Human-Like Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
summary:
We propose DeltaStreamer, a novel agentic framework for streaming video understanding inspired by how humans observe, remember, and investigate. Streaming video understanding requires a system to retain evidence before knowing which details future queries will need. Existing approaches often obscure event transitions and omit relevant details when compressing video history, and cannot recover missing visual evidence. DeltaStreamer addresses these limitations by combining change-aware memory with query-driven planning and targeted evidence gathering with replay. Before a query arrives, it continuously observes the stream and explicitly records visual changes in structured memory, preserving how events unfold rather than only what is present. When a query arrives, a query-driven planner identifies the required evidence and guides memory retrieval and targeted replay. By revisiting historical frames, the agent can recover visual details omitted during observation and ground its answer in evidence beyond the retained descriptions. This connects continuous observation with active investigation tailored to each question. Experiments on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench demonstrate improvements over representative streaming video understanding methods, with overall scores of 66.07% and 59.53%, respectively.
  Project page: https://bbbbchan.github.io/DeltaStreamer/
translation:
标题：DeltaStreamer：迈向类人的智能体式流式视频理解

摘要：我们提出了DeltaStreamer，一种受人类观察、记忆和探究方式启发的新型智能体框架，用于流式视频理解。流式视频理解要求系统在尚不清楚未来查询需要哪些细节之前就保留证据。现有方法在压缩视频历史时往往会模糊事件转换并遗漏相关细节，且无法恢复缺失的视觉证据。DeltaStreamer通过将变化感知记忆与查询驱动规划以及带有重放的定向证据收集相结合，解决了这些局限。在查询到来之前，它持续观察视频流，并在结构化记忆中显式记录视觉变化，保留事件如何展开的过程，而不仅仅是当前存在的内容。当查询到来时，查询驱动规划器识别所需证据，并引导记忆检索和定向重放。通过重新访问历史帧，智能体能够恢复观察过程中遗漏的视觉细节，并使其答案建立在超出所保留描述的证据之上。这将持续观察与针对每个问题的主动探究连接起来。在OVO-Bench和StreamingBench上的实验表明，该方法相较具有代表性的流式视频理解方法取得了提升，总体得分分别为66.07%和59.53%。
项目页面：https://bbbbchan.github.io/DeltaStreamer/

title: VLA-Δ: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer semantic knowledge acquired through vision-language pretraining to robot control, achieving strong performance across various benchmarks. However, most VLAs directly map observations to demonstrated actions without explicit supervision of intermediate physical state changes, making them prone to overfitting observation-action correspondences. Some methods introduce intermediate reasoning or future-state prediction in language, visual, or latent spaces to guide action generation, but do not explicitly supervise the physical state transition itself. We therefore propose VLA-Δ, a general framework that uses physical changes between current and future states as explicit learning targets. To support this objective, we construct a large-scale pretraining dataset and derive physical state-transition annotations covering task-relevant semantics and visual motion changes, providing more direct supervision for continuous action generation. During inference, the model generates actions directly from current observations without additional inference overhead. VLA-Δ achieves performance competitive with the state of the art on LIBERO and RoboTwin, and outperforms π_{0.5} in real-robot experiments. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta
translation:
标题：VLA-Δ：为视觉-语言-动作模型学习物理状态转换

摘要：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将通过视觉-语言预训练获得的语义知识迁移至机器人控制，在各类基准测试中取得了优异性能。然而，多数VLA模型直接将观测映射到示范动作，缺乏对中间物理状态变化的显式监督，因而容易过拟合观测-动作对应关系。部分方法在语言、视觉或潜在空间中引入中间推理或未来状态预测来引导动作生成，但并未对物理状态转换本身进行显式监督。为此，我们提出VLA-Δ，一个以当前状态与未来状态之间的物理变化作为显式学习目标的通用框架。为支撑该目标，我们构建了大规模预训练数据集，并推导出涵盖任务相关语义与视觉运动变化的物理状态转换标注，为连续动作生成提供更直接的监督。在推理阶段，模型直接从当前观测生成动作，无需额外的推理开销。VLA-Δ在LIBERO和RoboTwin上取得了与当前最优方法相当的性能，并在真实机器人实验中优于π_{0.5}。我们的代码发布于https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta

title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
summary: Video generators serve as interactive worlds for exploration and simulation, yet realistic and visually appealing frames do not necessarily depict a consistent 3D world. Existing benchmarks assess selected geometric properties or use vision-language models to judge memory and consistency, leaving systematic 3D evaluation underexplored. We introduce Orbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models. Through controlled exploration and revisit, we organize the evaluation into three dimensions: input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. For input preservation, registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors support appearance, geometry, and spatial stability measurements. For generated-content persistence, we compare revisits to regions absent from the input image with their first generated observations to test whether models preserve what they create. For 3D self-consistency, cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering test whether generated views describe the same 3D scene. Minute-long exploration and revisits further test long-term consistency. Our construction and annotation pipeline brings together public datasets, self-captured scenes, and simulation, yielding 720 instances across indoor and outdoor environments and six exploration-and-revisit protocols. Evaluation spans 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models through native-interface adapters. Our Orbia benchmark provides a systematic basis for diagnosing 3D inconsistency and developing more persistent video world models.
translation:
标题：Orbia：生成视频能否形成一致的3D世界？

摘要：视频生成器可充当用于探索与仿真的交互式世界，但逼真且视觉上吸引人的帧并不一定描绘出一致的3D世界。现有基准评估选定几何属性，或使用视觉-语言模型评判记忆与一致性，使系统性的3D评估仍未得到充分探索。我们提出 Orbia，这是首个专门用于系统且全面评估交互式世界模型中3D一致性的基准。通过受控探索与重访，我们将评估组织为三个维度：输入保持、生成内容持久性和3D自一致性。对于输入保持，配准的RGB-D参考和标注锚点支持外观、几何和空间稳定性测量。对于生成内容持久性，我们将对输入图像中不存在区域的重访与其首次生成观测进行比较，以测试模型是否保持其创建的内容。对于3D自一致性，跨视角深度与特征对应、区域尺度一致性以及留出高斯渲染测试生成的视图是否描述同一3D场景。长达一分钟的探索与重访进一步测试长期一致性。我们的构建与标注流程汇集了公共数据集、自采集场景和仿真，产生了跨室内外环境、六种探索-重访协议的720个实例。评估通过原生接口适配器涵盖了27个以文本、动作和相机为条件的模型。我们的 Orbia 基准为诊断3D不一致性以及开发更持久的视频世界模型提供了系统化基础。

title: WorldCast: Exploring Intelligent Visual Generation in World State Prediction
summary: Humans interpret multimodal observations of the world and forecast how it will evolve. Recent multimodal generative systems have demonstrated similar capabilities: they can integrate multimodal context and synthesize visual outputs that depict changes in the world. To characterize this emerging trajectory, we organize model capabilities into a four-level hierarchy and discover that higher-level tasks remain relatively underexplored despite model progress. To bridge this gap, we explore model performance on multi-step world state prediction, a high-level task that requires models to forecast successive future world states from multimodal observations and diverse references. Such a task requires models to possess entangled understanding and generation capabilities, as well as extensive world knowledge to translate human action sequences, physical transformations, and abstract visual reasoning into coherent visual outputs. We introduce WorldCast, a benchmark comprising 320 manually designed cases across eight categories, and evaluate 12 representative models. The conducted experiments yield three key insights: (a) advances in frontier models are rapidly pushing the boundaries of intelligent world modeling, with the GPT-Image-2.5 System scoring 72.8 and demonstrating early-stage visual state prediction capabilities on real-world tasks; (b) WorldCast reveals substantial gaps between models: even Nano Banana Pro reaches only 42.8 and the best open-source model scores 20.1, with deficits in handling complex context, entangled references, and reasoning-heavy tasks; (c) strong generative models effectively draw on the capabilities of their underlying language models. These findings highlight the need for multimodal generative models that are capable of dynamic planning and reasoning while also being deeply unified to faithfully simulate real-world states.
translation:
标题：WorldCast：探索世界状态预测中的智能视觉生成  
摘要：人类能够解读对世界的多模态观测，并预测世界将如何演变。近期的多模态生成系统已展现出类似能力：它们可以整合多模态上下文，并合成描绘世界变化的视觉输出。为刻画这一新兴发展轨迹，我们将模型能力组织为四级层次体系，并发现尽管模型不断进步，更高层级的任务仍相对未得到充分探索。为弥合这一差距，我们探究模型在多步世界状态预测上的表现；这是一项高层次任务，要求模型基于多模态观测和多样化参考，预测连续的未来世界状态。此类任务要求模型具备理解与生成相交织的能力，以及广泛的世界知识，以将人类动作序列、物理变换和抽象视觉推理转化为连贯的视觉输出。我们提出 WorldCast，一个包含八个类别、320 个人工设计案例的基准，并评估了 12 个代表性模型。实验得出三项关键洞见：(a) 前沿模型的进步正在迅速拓展智能世界建模的边界，其中 GPT-Image-2.5 系统得分 72.8，并展现出在真实世界任务上的早期视觉状态预测能力；(b) WorldCast 揭示了模型之间的显著差距：即便 Nano Banana Pro 也仅达到 42.8，最佳开源模型得分 20.1，且在处理复杂上下文、交织参考和推理密集型任务方面存在不足；(c) 强大的生成模型能够有效利用其底层语言模型的能力。这些发现凸显了对多模态生成模型的需求：这类模型需具备动态规划与推理能力，同时实现深度统一，以忠实模拟真实世界状态。

title: InfoVis: Unified Slide Image Generation and Editing
summary: Generating and editing presentation slides requires models to combine accurate text rendering, instruction following, visual grounding, aesthetic design, and precise editing within one canvas. Existing work covers only subsets of these capabilities and lacks large-scale slide-native supervision and diagnostic evaluation. We formulate four slide-centric tasks and build a scalable data engine with over 13M continual-pretraining records and 1.9M supervised fine-tuning records. We also introduce VisSlideBench, a benchmark of 1,527 manually screened instances that covers all four tasks with task-specific, multidimensional evaluation. Its automatic rankings agree with blinded, dimension-wise human rankings. Using these resources, we train InfoVis, a unified 9B slide generation and editing model. On VisSlideBench, InfoVis leads every evaluated open-source model on all eleven metrics and scores 7.94 overall against 7.99 for Nano-Banana-2. Starting from FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, slide-specific post-training adds 1.6 points overall, with the largest generation gains in content faithfulness; the remaining gap to proprietary models is smallest in content faithfulness and largest in aesthetic quality. Built on InfoVis, our document-to-slide workflow achieves the second-highest Aesthetics score on the external SlidesGen-Bench. We will release the model, code, data, and benchmark.
translation:
标题：InfoVis：统一的幻灯片图像生成与编辑

摘要：生成和编辑演示幻灯片要求模型在单一画布中融合准确的文本渲染、指令遵循、视觉定位、美学设计与精确编辑。现有工作仅覆盖这些能力的部分子集，并且缺乏大规模幻灯片原生监督与诊断性评估。我们定义了四个以幻灯片为中心的任务，并构建了一个可扩展的数据引擎，包含超过 1300 万条持续预训练记录和 190 万条监督微调记录。我们还提出了 VisSlideBench——一个包含 1,527 个经人工筛选实例的基准，以任务特定的多维度评估覆盖全部四项任务。其自动排名与盲法、逐维度的人工排名一致。利用这些资源，我们训练了 InfoVis，一个统一的 90 亿参数幻灯片生成与编辑模型。在 VisSlideBench 上，InfoVis 在全部十一项指标上领先所有被评估的开源模型，总体得分为 7.94，而 Nano-Banana-2 为 7.99。从 FLUX.2-klein-base-9B 出发，针对幻灯片的后训练使总体得分提升 1.6 分，其中生成方面在内容忠实度上的增益最大；与专有模型相比，剩余差距在内容忠实度上最小，在美学质量上最大。基于 InfoVis，我们的文档到幻灯片工作流在外部 SlidesGen-Bench 上取得了第二高的美学得分。我们将发布模型、代码、数据和基准。

title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.
translation:
标题：MLExpert：迈向自主机器学习工程的通用智能体模型

摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）正从辅助科学研究和工程实践，扩展到自主开发与改进AI系统，推动AI for AI（AI4AI）作为通向递归自我改进（RSI）的路径。工作流驱动的机器学习工程（MLE）系统通过管理长时程实验的复杂编排，为这一目标提供了切实可行的实现路径；而近期的MLE系统采用模型导向交互，使模型能够自主组织实验，并基于执行反馈自适应调整优化策略。然而，每次实验的反馈反映的是若干前置决策的结果，而一次长时程MLE运行包含大量此类高成本实验。因此，训练必须从长交互轨迹中筛选有效监督信号，并从中间结果中学习。我们提出一种面向自主长时程MLE优化的后训练方法，并将其用于训练MLExpert——一个35B的专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）智能体模型。我们设计了Kaggle-MLE Factory以构建可执行任务，并搭建用于模型导向实验的交互框架。分层智能体监督微调（SFT）通过结果引导的监督，将通用工具使用与编程能力迁移至MLE。窗口化交互强化学习（WIRL）将相邻实验结果之间的多轮决策视为一个执行窗口，并为其分配共享的基于结果的奖励。异步采集与策略校正支持在轨迹结束前进行策略更新。在MLE-Bench Lite上，MLExpert将基础模型的平均奖牌率从37.9%提升至72.7%，达到与Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3等更大规模前沿模型相当的性能。进一步实验表明，MLExpert在NatureBench Lite、智能体脚手架优化和算法优化上均取得性能提升，表明所习得的优化能力可泛化至其他任务。

title: Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch
summary: Data agents use code to process heterogeneous files and derive analytical insights. Scaling their training faces costly environment curation, privacy and intellectual-property restrictions, and difficulty verifying open-ended findings without known generative truth. Our core insight is to specify the world behind the files before generating the files themselves. We introduce Data World, a multi-agent engine that synthesizes environments, tasks, and rubrics from explicit mechanisms. Independent audits check target recoverability from observed files; rubrics support evaluation and RL rewards. Human preference-based curation for question realism selects 100 tasks across 50 held-out worlds and 16 domains for DataWorld-Bench. The engine also yields 2,135 training tasks from 1,037 disjoint worlds. Evaluation of ten frontier models shows that the benchmark remains challenging, particularly for insight discovery, with a consistent computation-insight gap. RL-zero training on the synthesized tasks produces DataWorld-35B-A3B from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B without trajectory distillation. Under matched evaluation, it improves over its base by 7.06 points on DataWorld-Bench, 14.28 on DAComp, 20.90 on DABstep-Hard, and 12.13 on JobBench, a broader occupational benchmark.
translation:
标题：Data World：从零开始扩展数据环境

摘要：数据智能体利用代码处理异构文件并得出分析性洞见。扩展其训练面临代价高昂的环境策管、隐私与知识产权限制，以及在没有已知生成真值时验证开放式发现的困难。我们的核心洞见是：在生成文件本身之前，先指定文件背后的世界。我们提出 Data World，一种多智能体引擎，可从显式机制合成环境、任务与评分细则。独立审计检验目标从观测文件中的可恢复性；评分细则支持评估与 RL 奖励。基于人类偏好的问题真实性策管为 DataWorld-Bench 选取了跨越 50 个留出世界、16 个领域的 100 个任务。该引擎还从 1,037 个互不相交的世界中产出 2,135 个训练任务。对十个前沿模型的评估表明，该基准仍具挑战性，尤其是在洞见发现方面，并存在一致的计算—洞见差距。在合成任务上进行 RL-zero 训练，可在无需轨迹蒸馏的情况下，从 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 得到 DataWorld-35B-A3B。在匹配评估下，它相较其基座模型在 DataWorld-Bench 上提升 7.06 分，在 DAComp 上提升 14.28 分，在 DABstep-Hard 上提升 20.90 分，在 JobBench（一个更广泛的职业基准）上提升 12.13 分。

title: Intern-Decision: Efficient Multimodal Decision Making with Autoregressive Masked Language Modeling
summary: Interactive agents repeatedly choose among a finite set of actions, labels, or ordinal outcomes. Generating a free-form response for each choice adds latency and complicates the interface between a model and its environment. We present Intern-Decision, a family of 0.8B, 2B, and 4B multimodal decision models that return structured choices and candidate probabilities from text and optional images. Our autoregressive masked language modeling objective places one decision placeholder per field in a complete assistant JSON skeleton. Ground-truth symbols appear only in supervision, while all fields are evaluated in a single causal forward pass using the backbone's native language-model head. The 4B model achieves a 90.02% unweighted average accuracy across seven evaluation suites, compared with 88.74% for Jev v1.13.0. For a fixed 289-token request with three fields on one RTX 4090, mean latency is 44.16 ms for the 4B model and approximately 33--34 ms for the smaller models. On a separate 96-case known-distribution pilot, temperature scaling reduces expected multiclass Brier from 0.628 to 0.550 and expected calibration error from 0.213 to 0.089. A confidence-based handoff study on 111 public Jevbench-Hard items improves accuracy from 82/111 (73.87%) to 97/111 (87.39%) by routing 42 items to Atria-Dawn-Preview. We also describe qualitative game, visual interface, and browser demonstrations. These results support compact decision models as a practical component of larger agent systems.
translation:
标题：Intern-Decision：基于自回归掩码语言建模的高效多模态决策

摘要：交互式智能体需要在有限的动作、标签或有序结果集合中反复选择。为每个选择生成自由形式的响应会增加延迟，并使模型与其环境之间的接口复杂化。我们提出Intern-Decision，一系列0.8B、2B和4B多模态决策模型，能够从文本和可选图像中返回结构化选择及候选概率。我们的自回归掩码语言建模目标在完整的助手JSON骨架中为每个字段放置一个决策占位符。真实符号仅出现在监督中，而所有字段通过骨干模型的原生语言模型头在单次因果前向传播中进行评估。4B模型在七个评估套件上达到了90.02%的未加权平均准确率，而Jev v1.13.0为88.74%。在一个RTX 4090上，对于包含三个字段的固定289-token请求，4B模型的平均延迟为44.16毫秒，较小模型约为33-34毫秒。在另一个96个案例的已知分布试点中，温度缩放将期望多分类Brier从0.628降至0.550，并将期望校准误差从0.213降至0.089。一项基于置信度的移交研究在111个公开Jevbench-Hard项目上，通过将42个项目路由至Atria-Dawn-Preview，将准确率从82/111（73.87%）提升至97/111（87.39%）。我们还描述了定性游戏、视觉界面和浏览器演示。这些结果支持将紧凑型决策模型作为大型智能体系统的实用组件。

title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
summary: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. It also matches much larger closed-source models, and beats several of them at Instruction Following and Product Integration - the two properties that determine whether an image can be published.
translation:
标题：CommerceGen-Studio：商业级主图生成的端到端框架

摘要：我们提出 CommerceGen-Studio，一个用于为电商库存量单位（SKU）生成商业级主图的端到端框架。该框架组织为信息抽取、语义改写和多条件生成三阶段流水线：Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent（PERL-Agent）通过由无参考评分标准评分的、由 VLM 与 LLM 角色构成的迭代闭环，将异构 SKU 元数据提炼为简洁的卖点文本列表。Layout Thinker Optimization（LTO）通过交替的领域特定策略优化，使改写器同时对齐文本描述与渲染图像质量。SKU-DiT 在 Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce（RDR）渐进式训练下训练，联合以白底产品图、商标裁剪图和结构化布局为条件，以同时保持主体保真度、商标完整性和字符级文本准确性。该框架已在生产环境中以每天数百万张主图的规模运行，单图延迟仅为数秒；我们认为这使其成为首批实现商业规模运行的此类系统之一。我们还发布了 CommerceGen-Bench，一个从所有商品类目的实时流量中收集的困难案例基准。在该基准上，在有提示增强和无提示增强的两条编辑赛道上，我们的框架均取得了所评估开源基线中最高的总体得分。它还可与规模远大于自身的闭源模型相媲美，并在指令遵循（Instruction Following）和产品整合（Product Integration）两项属性上优于其中若干模型——这两项属性决定了一张图像能否发布。

title: EdgeWise: Bringing Long-Horizon Agents to the Edge via Selective Cloud Delegation
summary: Complex and long-horizon agent tasks often rely on frontier models deployed in the cloud to achieve strong performance. However, using these models for every step of a long-horizon trajectory incurs substantial inference cost, even though not all steps may require the same level of model capability. In this paper, we find that allocating the LLM to only a small subset of key steps can achieve performance comparable to full LLM execution while significantly reducing inference cost. Motivated by this observation, we propose EdgeWise, an edge-cloud collaboration framework that deploys an SLM on the local device as the primary solver and selectively delegates critical steps to a cloud LLM when stronger model capacity is needed. To enable autonomous delegation without additional models at inference time, we introduce a step-level RL method that jointly optimizes task solving and delegation, with fine-grained credit assignment for individual delegation decisions. We also introduce an external judge-based delegation strategy and use it to systematically investigate key design choices in edge-cloud collaboration, including when to delegate, how delegation decisions should be made, what context should be shared, and how frequently the cloud LLM should be invoked. Experiments show that EdgeWise matches or outperforms pure-LLM execution while reducing inference cost up to 62% on SWE-Rebench and 34% on Terminal-Bench 2.1. We further deploy EdgeWise on a local workstation, demonstrating comparable cost savings in a practical edge-cloud setting.
translation:
标题：EdgeWise：通过选择性云端委派将长时程智能体引入边缘

摘要：复杂且长时程的智能体任务通常依赖部署在云端的前沿模型来获得强劲性能。然而，在长时程轨迹的每一步都使用这些模型会带来巨大的推理成本，尽管并非所有步骤都需要相同水平的模型能力。本文发现，仅将大语言模型分配给少量关键步骤即可达到与全程使用大语言模型相当的性能，同时显著降低推理成本。受此观察启发，我们提出EdgeWise，一种边云协作框架，在本地设备上部署小语言模型作为主要求解器，并在需要更强模型能力时选择性地将关键步骤委派给云端大语言模型。为在推理时无需额外模型即可实现自主委派，我们提出一种步级强化学习方法，联合优化任务求解与委派决策，并对单个委派决策进行细粒度信用分配。我们还引入一种基于外部评判者的委派策略，并利用它系统地研究边云协作中的关键设计选择，包括何时委派、如何做出委派决策、应共享什么上下文以及云端大语言模型应以何种频率被调用。实验表明，EdgeWise在SWE-Rebench上达到或超过纯大语言模型执行的性能，同时将推理成本降低最多62%，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上降低34%。我们进一步在本地工作站上部署EdgeWise，证明其在实际边云环境中也能实现相当的成本节约。

title: Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine
summary: Converting verifier outcomes into useful policy updates and partial progress into complete task resolution is crucial for terminal agents. We present Terminal-RSI, which alternates Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR) of verified trajectories with critic-inheriting Recursive Policy-Refine (RPR). We formulate Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE (TB-GAE) to retain token-specific baselines while applying decay across interaction turns. Family Dense Reward (FDR) calibrates semantic progress across task families; Success-Prioritized Reward (SPR) separates strict success from bounded partial credit. A Warm-up Critic Model, recursive critic handoff, and stage-specific learning rates coordinate the two refinement phases. The five-stage sequence from Qwen3.8-27B base model through RSR-1, RPR-1, RSR-2, and RPR-2 yields Terminal-RSI-27B: 19.84% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, 86.52% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 16.95% on Terminal-Bench 3.0, and 79.00% on Terminal-Bench Hard. On LHTB, process reward rises from 0.21 to 0.37 and strict completion from 0/46 to 5/46; SWR100 success doubles from 3.00% to 6.00%. By recursively coupling verified trajectory rewriting with critic-inheriting policy refinement, each retained stage consolidates discovered behaviors and progressively advances the agent from partial local repairs to strict terminal verification.
translation:
标题：Terminal-RSI：通过递归自重写与策略精炼实现递归自改进的终端智能体  
摘要：将验证器结果转化为有用的策略更新，并将部分进展转化为完整任务解决，对终端智能体至关重要。我们提出 Terminal-RSI，它交替执行对已验证轨迹的递归自重写（RSR）与继承评论家的递归策略精炼（RPR）。我们提出轮次边界跳过观测 GAE（TB-GAE），以在跨交互轮次应用衰减的同时保留 token 特定基线。任务族稠密奖励（FDR）校准跨任务族的语义进展；成功优先奖励（SPR）将严格成功与有界部分得分区分开。预热评论家模型、递归评论家交接和阶段特定学习率协调两个精炼阶段。从 Qwen3.8-27B 基础模型出发，经过 RSR-1、RPR-1、RSR-2 和 RPR-2 的五阶段序列得到 Terminal-RSI-27B：在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上为 19.84%，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上为 86.52%，在 Terminal-Bench 3.0 上为 16.95%，在 Terminal-Bench Hard 上为 79.00%。在 LHTB 上，过程奖励从 0.21 升至 0.37，严格完成从 0/46 提升至 5/46；SWR100 成功率从 3.00% 翻倍至 6.00%。通过递归耦合已验证轨迹重写与继承评论家的策略精炼，每个保留阶段巩固已发现的行为，并逐步推动智能体从部分局部修复迈向严格的终端验证。

title: Routing Policy Optimization for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. We instead ask whether stochastic exploration can be introduced inside the generator while preserving its original sampler. Routing Policy Optimization (RPO) answers this question by turning attention routing into a stochastic exploration action. At a few selected denoising levels, each query block keeps its own block and samples further key blocks in proportion to the generator's native attention mass, or keeps dense attention. The sampled route perturbs the velocity of that transition, and a Gaussian likelihood around the dense velocity scores the perturbation with a score-function objective. RPO further uses a controlled two-rollout estimator: two rollouts share the same prompt, initial latent, routed denoising levels, and dense anchor layers, differing only in their sampled attention routes. Their reward difference provides an advantage signal for the routed transitions. Because the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity itself, the learned updates remain effective after routing is removed. At inference, RPO restores dense attention and retains the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that RPO improves generation quality while achieving nearly 4x higher training efficiency than Flow-GRPO-style methods. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/rpo for visual results.
translation:
标题：面向在线扩散强化学习的路由策略优化

摘要：强化学习能够使视觉生成器与超出其预训练目标的奖励信号对齐，但现有的得分函数方法通常通过扰动反向去噪轨迹来引入随机性，从而导致成本高昂的基于 rollout 的优化。我们转而探讨是否可以在保持生成器原始采样器的同时，在生成器内部引入随机探索。路由策略优化（RPO）通过将注意力路由转化为随机探索动作来回答这一问题。在少数选定的去噪层级上，每个查询块保留其自身块，并按照生成器原生注意力质量的比例采样其他键块，或者保持稠密注意力。采样得到的路由会扰动该转移的速度，而围绕稠密速度的高斯似然以得分函数目标对该扰动进行评分。RPO 进一步使用受控的双 rollout 估计器：两次 rollout 共享相同的提示、初始潜变量、路由去噪层级和稠密锚定层，仅在其采样的注意力路由上不同。它们的奖励差异为路由转移提供优势信号。由于该似然对稠密速度本身求导，在移除路由后，学习到的更新仍然有效。在推理时，RPO 恢复稠密注意力，并保留原始确定性采样器。在文本到图像和文本到视频生成上的实验表明，RPO 提升了生成质量，同时训练效率接近 Flow-GRPO 类方法的 4 倍。请访问我们的项目页面 https://velox-world.com/rpo 查看可视化结果。

title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
summary: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.
translation:
标题：OmniVerifier-C1：用于规则约束生成式世界建模的分解式分级验证器

摘要：生成式视觉验证器在推动多模态智能发展方面发挥着关键作用。为了增强视觉验证器在涉及组合性要求的复杂多模态场景中的鲁棒性，我们超越了仅输出真/假离散判断的传统二值验证器，提出了一种能够自动将复杂提示或环境规则分解为细粒度组件并分配逐点分数的验证器，从而提供连续且信息更丰富的评判信号。我们的实验进一步表明，这些结构化且可解释的输出提升了验证器对域外多模态评判任务的泛化能力。为训练该验证器，我们引入了一种解耦强化学习（Decoupled RL）训练策略，该策略联合优化子问题级二值判断与全局对齐评分，并利用精确的局部反馈来培养细粒度验证能力，为全局层面可靠的连续评分奠定基础。在通用强化学习框架下，我们首先通过实证证明，所提出的逐点分级验证器在传统文本到图像场景中显著优于二值验证器。随后，我们将研究扩展到规则约束下的生成式世界建模，其中生成模型被用于在显式规则下进行世界模拟和世界推理。从理论角度看，我们进一步表明，当存在真实图像时，成对验证范式比逐点形式能产生更准确的评判；在迷宫（Maze）和数独（Sudoku）等多样结构化世界建模任务上的实证结果，进一步验证了我们方法的有效性。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了一个关键洞见：从生成模型向结构化世界建模智能体的转变，关键取决于是否具备准确的成对分级视觉验证器。

title: Do Better Visual Representations Always Lead to Better End-to-End Autonomous Driving?
summary: Visual foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly integrated into end-to-end autonomous driving for their powerful representations, yet it remains unclear when these representations improve driving performance. To investigate this question, we introduce ViRA, a planner-agnostic visual representation alignment framework that keeps the planner architecture and inference cost unchanged. Our study reveals three findings: (1) VFM-guided visual representations consistently improve driving performance across diverse end-to-end planners, with gains extending to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation. (2) The choice of VFM target matters for planning performance, and alignment to a different VFM can further benefit planners with pre-trained VFM encoders. (3) Auxiliary perception supervision reduces sensitivity to VFM target selection, narrowing the EPDMS spread across five targets from 2.7 to 0.5 points and potentially compensating for less effective VFM targets. Guided by these findings, we develop ViRA-Diffusion, a diffusion-based planner trained without auxiliary perception supervision, which achieves 92.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest, outperforming recent methods in our comparison by at least 1.9 points. The results motivate jointly considering target selection and planner supervision when integrating VFMs into end-to-end autonomous driving. The results and demo are available at https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/ViRA.
translation:
标题：更好的视觉表征总能带来更好的端到端自动驾驶吗？

摘要：视觉基础模型（VFMs）因其强大的表征能力而被日益集成到端到端自动驾驶中，然而这些表征何时能够提升驾驶性能仍不明确。为探究这一问题，我们提出了ViRA，一种与规划器无关的视觉表征对齐框架，该框架保持规划器架构和推理成本不变。我们的研究揭示了三个发现：（1）VFM引导的视觉表征在多种端到端规划器上均能持续提升驾驶性能，且增益可扩展至零样本闭环评估。（2）VFM目标的选择对规划性能有影响，对齐到不同的VFM可进一步使具有预训练VFM编码器的规划器受益。（3）辅助感知监督降低了对VFM目标选择的敏感性，将五个目标间的EPDMS差距从2.7分缩小至0.5分，并有可能补偿效果较差的VFM目标。在这些发现的指导下，我们开发了ViRA-Diffusion，一种基于扩散的规划器，在无辅助感知监督的情况下训练，在NAVSIM v2 navtest上达到92.3 EPDMS，在我们所比较的方法中至少领先1.9分。这些结果说明，在将VFM集成到端到端自动驾驶中时，有必要联合考虑目标选择和规划器监督。结果和演示见https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/ViRA。

title: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
summary: Driving world action models (WAMs) learn from paired trajectories and future observations. Post-training with reinforcement learning allows the policy to explore alternative trajectories and improve planning using driving rewards. However, driving logs contain future videos only for the recorded trajectories, leaving these alternatives without corresponding visual supervision. Thus, we introduce SimVTA, a simulation-grounded post-training framework that combines trajectory optimization with video supervision. First, we sample candidate trajectories for each observation and use a real-world simulator (e.g., World Engine) to render future videos for high-reward candidates in real-world scenes reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This provides trajectory-matched supervision independent of the model's own predictions. Under a limited rendering budget, we prioritize video supervision for higher-error futures among these rendered candidates. Finally, we optimize trajectory planning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use a flow-matching loss on the matched videos to update shared representations. At inference time, the model predicts trajectories directly, without simulator calls. On NAVSIM v1, applying SimVTA to a WAM initialization improves PDMS from 86.2 to 91.3 (+5.1). It achieves 88.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and an average HD-Score of 38.8 in closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show that updating shared representations with video supervision improves planning, while prioritizing higher-error futures among high-reward trajectories further improves performance.
translation:
标题：SimVTA：面向驾驶世界动作模型的基于仿真的视频-轨迹对齐

摘要：驾驶世界动作模型（WAMs）从成对轨迹与未来观测中学习。使用强化学习进行后训练，可使策略探索替代轨迹，并利用驾驶奖励改进规划。然而，驾驶日志仅包含记录轨迹的未来视频，导致这些替代轨迹缺乏相应的视觉监督。因此，我们提出 SimVTA，一种基于仿真的后训练框架，将轨迹优化与视频监督相结合。首先，我们为每个观测采样候选轨迹，并在通过 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建的真实世界场景中，使用真实世界模拟器（例如 World Engine）为高奖励候选轨迹渲染未来视频。这提供了独立于模型自身预测的、与轨迹匹配的监督。在有限渲染预算下，我们优先为这些已渲染候选轨迹中误差较高的未来施加视频监督。最后，我们使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化轨迹规划，并对匹配视频采用流匹配损失来更新共享表示。在推理时，模型直接预测轨迹，无需调用模拟器。在 NAVSIM v1 上，将 SimVTA 应用于 WAM 初始化，将 PDMS 从 86.2 提升至 91.3（+5.1）。在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 88.2 EPDMS，并在 HUGSIM 的闭环评估中取得 38.8 的平均 HD-Score。消融实验表明，使用视频监督更新共享表示可改进规划，而在高奖励轨迹中优先关注误差较高的未来可进一步提升性能。

title: SWE-at-Scale: Scalable Issue Synthesis from Historical Bug Fixes
summary: As coding agents become increasingly capable, robust evaluation requires a broader and more diverse supply of verifiable software engineering (SWE) tasks. However, real-world tasks are constrained by the natural frequency of issue reporting and the substantial cost of manual curation. Furthermore, existing synthetic approaches rely primarily on the pretrained knowledge of large models coupled with heuristic prompting, often failing to capture the authentic, complex mechanics of software failures. To exponentially scale SWE task production, we introduce SWE-at-Scale, a framework that automatically synthesizes realistic issues by reverse-engineering real-world software fixes. Our key insight is that historical fixes encapsulate deep mechanistic knowledge of bug formation: inverting a fix transforms repair supervision into bug-induction supervision grounded in actual development scenarios. SWE-at-Scale transfers these learned bug patterns to novel code contexts, repeatedly sampling diverse bug typologies to construct executable SWE tasks. Extensive experiments show that SWE-at-Scale generates more diverse and realistic SWE tasks than current synthesis baselines while posing greater challenges to state-of-the-art coding agents. Notably, SWE-at-Scale can generate distinct bug types from a single code context, with bug diversity scaling robustly even up to 200 generations per file. Overall, SWE-at-Scale turns finite real-world fixes into reusable supervision for scalable synthesis of realistic, diverse, and challenging SWE tasks.
translation:
标题：SWE-at-Scale：基于历史缺陷修复的可扩展问题合成

摘要：随着编码智能体能力日益增强，稳健评估需要更广泛、更多样的可验证软件工程（SWE）任务供给。然而，真实世界任务受限于问题报告的自然频率以及人工整理的高昂成本。此外，现有合成方法主要依赖大模型的预训练知识并结合启发式提示，往往无法捕捉软件故障真实而复杂的机理。为实现 SWE 任务生产的指数级扩展，我们提出 SWE-at-Scale——一个通过逆向工程真实软件修复来自动合成逼真问题的框架。我们的核心洞见是：历史修复蕴含了缺陷形成的深层机理知识；反转一个修复可将修复监督转化为基于实际开发场景的缺陷诱导监督。SWE-at-Scale 将这些习得的缺陷模式迁移到新的代码上下文中，反复采样多样的缺陷类型，以构建可执行 SWE 任务。大量实验表明，与当前合成基线相比，SWE-at-Scale 能生成更多样、更逼真的 SWE 任务，同时对最先进的编码智能体构成更大挑战。值得注意的是，SWE-at-Scale 能够从单一代码上下文中生成不同的缺陷类型，且即使每个文件生成多达 200 次，缺陷多样性仍能稳健扩展。总体而言，SWE-at-Scale 将有限的真实世界修复转化为可复用监督，用于可扩展地合成逼真、多样且具有挑战性的 SWE 任务。

title: Each Reward to Its Relevant Tokens: Reward-Specific Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Reward RL
summary: Language models are increasingly trained against several verifiable rewards at once, such as the correctness and the format of a tool call, or the individual constraints of a complex instruction. Reward-decoupled normalization (GDPO) normalizes each reward separately so that different reward combinations keep distinct advantages, but it still spreads every reward's advantage evenly over the whole response, although each verifier checks only a few positions. We propose MRTPO, which assigns the advantage of each reward to the tokens relevant to it, using the information its verifier checks, without auxiliary models or token-level annotations. For each reward, the policy replays its own response with and without that reward's verifier information, and the per-token Jensen-Shannon distance between the two next-token distributions measures each token's relevance and reassigns the advantage. On text-to-SQL, multi-constraint instruction following and tool calling, MRTPO converges faster and achieves better performance than the compared methods.
translation:
标题：各奖励归其相关词元：面向多奖励强化学习的奖励特定词元级信用分配

摘要：语言模型越来越多地同时针对多个可验证奖励进行训练，例如工具调用的正确性与格式，或复杂指令的各项约束。奖励解耦归一化（GDPO）对每个奖励分别进行归一化，从而使不同的奖励组合保持不同的优势值，但它仍然将每个奖励的优势均匀地分摊到整个回复上，尽管每个验证器只检查少数位置。我们提出MRTPO，它将每个奖励的优势分配给与其相关的词元，利用其验证器所检查的信息，无需辅助模型或词元级标注。对于每个奖励，策略分别在包含和不包含该奖励验证器信息的条件下重放自身回复，两个下一词元分布之间的逐词元Jensen-Shannon距离衡量每个词元的相关性并重新分配优势。在文本到SQL、多约束指令遵循和工具调用任务上，MRTPO相比对比方法收敛更快且性能更优。

title: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient
summary: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Velox, a training-free attention router for region-level context selection using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. Velox represents historical blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and obtains current-block depth through recency-priority multiwarp. For well-covered regions, frustum slab overlap softly modulates each layer's model-derived block importance. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. The fixed token-block granularity matches FlashAttention-style tiled execution and reduces the attention term that grows with rollout length. Frustum slab construction runs asynchronously with denoising on the same H200. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by 4.36times and denoising by 2.43times. On the full 158-case WBench navigation split, it remains within 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/velox/ for more details.
translation:
标题：Velox：空间记忆让世界模型更高效

摘要：视频世界模型将动作与相机运动转化为长时间视觉推演，使视频成为交互式仿真的自然接口。此类交互要求生成具有响应性，而连贯的推演又必须保留已生成内容的视觉记忆。分块视频扩散模型通常将这种上下文保存在不断增长的KV缓存中，导致后续分块逐渐变慢。为解决这一瓶颈，我们提出Velox，一种免训练的注意力路由器，利用流式几何中的视锥切片对应关系进行区域级上下文选择。Velox将历史块表示为带有深度区间的相机视锥切片，并通过优先最近的多重变换获得当前块深度。对于覆盖良好的区域，视锥切片重叠会软调制每一层由模型推导的块重要性。未覆盖区域则保留模型推导的路由，不引入几何偏置。固定的令牌块粒度与FlashAttention风格的平铺执行相匹配，并减少了随推演长度增长的注意力项。视锥切片构建与去噪在同一H200上异步运行。在第48个分块处，Velox将注意力加速4.36倍，去噪加速2.43倍。在完整的158例WBench导航划分上，其与稠密LingBot-Fast-Cam的无API平均分差距保持在0.15分以内。更多详情请参见我们的项目页面：https://velox-world.com/velox/。

title: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents now fix software, operate computers and serve customers, but their harnesses, the programs that run them, call a large LLM at every step, which makes long tasks slow and costly. Most of these calls end in a multiple-choice decision, such as which tool to call next. Decision models such as Jev answer these questions directly, at a fraction of an LLM call's time and price. We ask how a harness can delegate these decisions to a decision model with little loss of success. To evaluate decision models in agentic tasks, we build AgentDecisionBench, which tests them from isolated questions up to control of a running agent, on public benchmarks and our DecisionGym environment. The decision model most accurate on isolated questions solved only 69.5% of agent tasks, and without a fitted confidence threshold, delegating tool choices lowered success by 19.0 points. Building on these findings, we then design JevAgentHarness, which fits this threshold for each choice on the agent's own trajectories and lets the LLM decide below it. Because existing decision models never see the states an agent reaches after its own mistakes, we train AgentDecision-4B, an open 4B model, on such states with Jev's answers as labels. On tasks unlike its training data, the agent solved 91.5% of them with AgentDecision-4B and 82.0% with Jev. On tasks like their training data, 4B models trained this way made agents 81.1-89.0% cheaper and up to 2.5 times faster, without losing 3 or more points of task success. The models, data, and harness will be released at https://github.com/JevAgentHarness/JevAgentHarness.
translation:
标题：JevAgentHarness：对与LLM共享控制权的决策模型进行基准测试、部署和训练

摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体如今能够修复软件、操作计算机并服务客户，但其执行框架——即运行它们的程序——在每一步都会调用大型LLM，这使得长任务变得缓慢且成本高昂。这些调用大多以多项选择决策告终，例如下一步调用哪个工具。诸如Jev之类的决策模型能够以远低于LLM调用的时间和价格直接回答这些问题。我们研究执行框架如何在几乎不损失成功率的情况下将这些决策委托给决策模型。为了在智能体任务中评估决策模型，我们构建了AgentDecisionBench，该基准在公开基准和我们自建的DecisionGym环境中，从孤立问题到对运行中智能体的控制对其进行测试。在孤立问题上最准确的决策模型仅解决了69.5%的智能体任务，而在没有拟合置信度阈值的情况下，委托工具选择使成功率下降了19.0个百分点。基于这些发现，我们设计了JevAgentHarness，它在智能体自身的轨迹上为每个选择拟合该阈值，并让LLM在低于阈值时进行决策。由于现有决策模型从未见过智能体在自身犯错后所到达的状态，我们训练了AgentDecision-4B——一个开放的4B模型——在此类状态上以Jev的答案为标签进行训练。在与训练数据不同的任务上，使用AgentDecision-4B的智能体解决了91.5%的任务，使用Jev的解决了82.0%。在与训练数据相似的任务上，以这种方式训练的4B模型使智能体的成本降低了81.1-89.0%，速度提升高达2.5倍，同时任务成功率损失不超过3个百分点。模型、数据和执行框架将在https://github.com/JevAgentHarness/JevAgentHarness发布。

title: MFVSR: A Multi-Style and Fine-Grained Benchmark for Video Subtitle Removal
summary: Video subtitle removal (VSR) is an important video restoration task, yet existing evaluation remains limited by low-resolution datasets, fragmented test sets, and generic video-inpainting protocols that fail to adequately capture localized restoration errors, unintended modifications, temporal instability, and incomplete outputs. In this paper, we introduce MFVSR, a large-scale multi-style benchmark for fine-grained and reliability-aware video subtitle removal evaluation. MFVSR distinguishes itself through three key features: (1) Large-scale and diverse data, comprising 3,000 paired videos from Real-HQ, Real-LQ, and AI-Generated sources, with an auxiliary set of 953 in-the-wild real videos for real-world coverage analysis; (2) Controlled subtitle diversity, spanning 16 languages and four factors covering spatial layout, temporal behavior, visual style, and language mode; (3) Fine-grained evaluation, introducing an information-conditioned, spatially decoupled protocol that separates blind from mask-guided removal and measures Restoration Fidelity, Preservation Fidelity, Temporal Fidelity, coverage, and failures. Experiments on six representative methods reveal substantial discrepancies between local restoration, outside-region preservation, temporal consistency, and full-set reliability that are obscured by conventional full-frame metrics. MFVSR therefore provides a more comprehensive and diagnostic foundation for evaluating and advancing video subtitle removal methods.
translation:
标题：MFVSR：面向视频字幕移除的多风格与细粒度基准
摘要：视频字幕移除（VSR）是一项重要的视频复原任务，然而现有评估仍受限于低分辨率数据集、碎片化测试集以及通用视频修补（inpainting）协议，这些协议无法充分捕捉局部复原误差、非预期修改、时序不稳定性和输出不完整等问题。本文提出 MFVSR，一个面向细粒度且可靠性感知的视频字幕移除评估的大规模多风格基准。MFVSR 的特色体现在三个关键特征上：（1）大规模且多样化的数据，包含来自 Real-HQ、Real-LQ 和 AI 生成来源的 3,000 个配对视频，并附带由 953 个真实场景（in-the-wild）视频组成的辅助集，用于真实世界覆盖分析；（2）可控的字幕多样性，涵盖 16 种语言以及空间布局、时序行为、视觉风格和语言模式四类因素；（3）细粒度评估，引入一种信息条件化、空间解耦的协议，将盲式移除与掩码引导移除区分开来，并度量复原保真度、保持保真度、时序保真度、覆盖率与失败情况。在六种代表性方法上的实验揭示了局部复原、区域外保持、时序一致性和全集可靠性之间的显著差异，而这些差异被传统全帧指标所掩盖。因此，MFVSR 为评估和推进视频字幕移除方法提供了更全面且更具诊断性的基础。

title: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
summary: Large language model agents solve tasks through long sequences of tool calls, and the prevailing design has a single strong model generate every step, although many steps are routine enough for a much smaller model.
