Existing ways of sharing this work keep the strong model as the generator: routers and collaborative agents decide which model handles each query or step, and speculative methods check a small model's drafts one step at a time, usually against the strong model's own action. We introduce SpecAgent, a collaboration protocol that turns the strong model from the author of each step into a reviewer of steps drafted by a weak model. The weak model executes read-only tool calls as it drafts, so that every step is grounded in real observations, and holds the first action that would modify the environment. The strong model then verifies the drafted segment in a single prefill pass, commits the longest prefix it judges semantically valid, and repairs the first rejected step. Because verification replaces autoregressive decoding with parallel prefill, the strong model decodes only short verdicts and occasional repairs rather than every step. On τ^2-Bench, SpecAgent comes within one point of the strong model's success rate while roughly halving memory traffic and wall time, and on AutomationBench and VitaBench it recovers 44-75% of the quality gap while lowering both. In an edge-cloud deployment on MCP-Atlas with three cloud models, it closes 53-75% of the weak-strong quality gap while the strong model generates at most half as many tokens. These results suggest that a strong model need not author every step of an agent: reviewing grounded drafts retains most of its quality while cutting both latency and memory traffic.
translation:
标题：面向工具使用智能体的轨迹级推测与语义验证

摘要：大语言模型智能体通过长序列的工具调用解决任务，而主流设计是由单个强模型生成每一步，尽管许多步骤足够常规，可由小得多的模型完成。现有的工作分担方式仍将强模型作为生成者：路由器与协作式智能体决定由哪个模型处理每个查询或步骤，推测式方法则通常对照强模型自身的动作，逐步检查小模型的草稿。我们提出 SpecAgent，一种协作协议，将强模型从每一步的作者转变为弱模型所起草步骤的审查者。弱模型在起草时执行只读工具调用，使每一步都基于真实观测，并保留第一个将修改环境的动作。随后，强模型在单次预填充中验证所起草的片段，提交其判定为语义有效的最长前缀，并修复第一个被拒绝的步骤。由于验证以并行预填充替代自回归解码，强模型仅解码简短判定和偶尔的修复，而非每一步。在 τ^2-Bench 上，SpecAgent 的成功率与强模型相差不到一个百分点，同时将内存流量和墙钟时间大致减半；在 AutomationBench 和 VitaBench 上，它弥补了 44–75% 的质量差距，同时降低了这两项指标。在 MCP-Atlas 上使用三个云模型进行边缘-云部署时，它弥合了弱模型与强模型之间 53–75% 的质量差距，而强模型至多只生成一半的 token。这些结果表明，强模型无需编写智能体的每一步：审查基于真实观测的草稿即可保留其大部分质量，同时降低延迟和内存流量。

title: Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research
summary: Recursive self-improvement, in which AI systems build stronger AI systems, is one promising route to superintelligence. We study a weaker form that can be measured today: frontier agents post-training a small raw base model with public data, as a test of their research potential. We build Athanor, an open agent-native system for autonomous post-training research (AutoPostTrain) on real GPUs. We give the agents full research autonomy, low-friction engineering tools, and efficient starter code. The agents carry out the research themselves: they read datasets and evaluation results, build their training data, write and modify training algorithms, tune hyperparameters, and analyze the results to decide what to try next. They work in a sandbox and cannot use external teacher models. Athanor's services supply frozen evaluation, managed jobs, decontaminated data, a persistent research record, and a held-out suite the agents are unaware of. In a 104-hour campaign, a team of four Claude Opus 5.5 agents, each on an eight-GPU node and given no research advice, improves Qwen3-4B-Base from 15.9 to 67.3 on a six-task development suite and from 9.2 to 48.2 on a held-out suite, against 66.5 and 47.9 for the official Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a team of frontier agents can autonomously post-train a raw base model into a cross-domain generalist model that matches or surpasses the official instruct version on average. The campaign's full record shows that the agents reach this level by recombining known methods and each other's models: SFT on public reasoning data, RL with a rollout change one agent introduced, weight merges across agents, and rounds of self-distillation. With execution handled, today's agents already have the engineering and research ability to conquer this task. We hope Athanor provides a foundation for scaling autonomous AI research.
translation:
标题：Athanor：面向自主后训练研究的智能体原生系统

摘要：递归自我改进，即AI系统构建更强的AI系统，是通往超级智能的一条有前景路径。我们研究一种当前可测量的较弱形式：前沿智能体使用公开数据对小型原始基础模型进行后训练，以此检验其研究潜力。我们构建了Athanor，一个开放、智能体原生的系统，用于在真实GPU上进行自主后训练研究（AutoPostTrain）。我们赋予智能体完全的研究自主权、低摩擦工程工具和高效起始代码。智能体自行开展研究：阅读数据集与评估结果，构建训练数据，编写并修改训练算法，调优超参数，并分析结果以决定下一步尝试。它们在沙盒中工作，不能使用外部教师模型。Athanor的服务提供冻结评估、托管作业、去污染数据、持久化研究记录，以及智能体并不知晓的留出套件。在为期104小时的实验活动中，由四个Claude Opus 5.5智能体组成的团队，每个智能体运行于一个八GPU节点，且未获得任何研究建议，将Qwen3-4B-Base在六任务开发套件上从15.9提升至67.3，在留出套件上从9.2提升至48.2；官方Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507的相应成绩为66.5和47.9。据我们所知，这是首次证明一支前沿智能体团队能够自主地将原始基础模型后训练为跨领域通用模型，并在平均表现上匹配或超越官方指令版本。该实验活动的完整记录显示，智能体通过重新组合已知方法及彼此的模型达到这一水平：在公开推理数据上进行SFT、采用某一智能体引入的rollout改动进行RL、跨智能体权重合并，以及多轮自蒸馏。在执行环节得到处理的前提下，当今的智能体已具备攻克这一任务所需的工程与研究能力。我们希望Athanor为自主AI研究的规模化提供基础。

title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
summary: While generalist vision-language-action (VLA) models have enabled diverse open-world manipulation, real-world robotic assistance requires two critical capabilities they currently lack: personalization and reliable execution. First, executing an instruction like "make me a sandwich" requires grounding subtask decomposition in persistent user preferences rather than relying on a single generic solution. Second, reliable deployment demands explainable safety assurance that proactively prevents hazards and gracefully recovers from occasional physical failures. To address these gaps, we present CarryOn, a dual-loop harness designed to augment a frozen VLA policy. The planning loop maintains persistent user-level and scene-level context that is continually grounded against new observations and revised through interaction, enabling personalized task selection and execution grounding across conversations and changing scenes. The execution loop actively supervises policy rollouts, shielding actions from predicted hazardous contact. When execution fails, the system invokes reusable control-based recovery skills that restore task progress and are refined through reflection on earlier failures. On a real robot and in simulation, CarryOn dispatches preference-consistent subtasks across users and scenes, reduces the violation rate of an already safety-finetuned VLA from 52.6% to 6.1%, and increases recovery success from 13% to 80% when refined skills are reused.
translation:
标题：CarryOn：一种面向个性化与可靠机器人辅助的双环路框架

摘要：尽管通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已支持多样化的开放世界操作，但真实世界中的机器人辅助仍需两项其目前尚不具备的关键能力：个性化与可靠执行。首先，执行诸如“给我做个三明治”之类的指令，需要将子任务分解建立在持久的用户偏好之上，而非依赖单一的通用解决方案。其次，可靠部署需要可解释的安全保障，以主动预防危险，并在偶发物理故障后优雅恢复。为弥补这些不足，我们提出 CarryOn，一种旨在增强冻结 VLA 策略的双环路框架。规划环维护持久的用户级和场景级上下文，该上下文持续依据新观测进行落地，并通过交互加以修正，从而支持跨对话及变化场景的个性化任务选择与执行落地。执行环主动监督策略展开，对动作进行防护以避开预测到的危险接触。当执行失败时，系统调用可复用的基于控制的恢复技能来恢复任务进度，并通过对先前失败的反思对这些技能进行改进。在真实机器人与仿真中，CarryOn 能跨用户和场景分派符合偏好的子任务，将已安全微调的 VLA 的违规率从 52.6% 降至 6.1%，并在复用改进技能时将恢复成功率从 13% 提升至 80%。

title: Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos
summary: Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) must continuously integrate information from the past while remaining responsive to current observations and user queries. Existing memory mechanisms typically compress, retrieve, or cache historical observations and reintroduce them into the input context, forcing historical memory and current observations to compete for limited context. We propose MaLoW, a streaming memory framework that instead internalizes historical context into evolving lightweight parameter updates. MaLoW uses a recurrent HyperNetwork to incrementally consolidate incoming video observations into fixed-size LoRA weights, allowing historical information to be carried forward without revisiting the full video stream. In doing so, MaLoW represents history as weights, while keeping the current observation as input. To support training, we further construct MaLoW-Instruct, a large-scale streaming video dataset containing 381K question-answer pairs over 56K videos. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate that MaLoW achieves strong performance on OVO-Bench, StreamingBench, and StreamArena. On the backward split of OVO-Bench, MaLoW outperforms prior memory approaches by 3.9% to 11.8% across different video backbones while incurring only modest latency overhead. Beyond streaming video understanding, MaLoW also generalizes to vision-language-action models, improving the action success rate on Simpler WidowX by 9.3%.
translation:
标题：记忆即权重：将长期历史内化用于流式视频

摘要：流式视觉语言模型（VLM）必须持续整合过去的信息，同时对当前观察和用户查询保持响应。现有的记忆机制通常压缩、检索或缓存历史观察，并将其重新引入输入上下文，迫使历史记忆与当前观察争夺有限的上下文。我们提出MaLoW，一种流式记忆框架，转而将历史上下文内化为不断演化的轻量级参数更新。MaLoW使用循环HyperNetwork将输入的视频观察增量式地整合为固定大小的LoRA权重，使历史信息得以延续，而无需重新访问完整视频流。由此，MaLoW将历史表示为权重，同时将当前观察保留为输入。为支持训练，我们进一步构建了MaLoW-Instruct，一个大规模流式视频数据集，包含56K个视频上的381K个问答对。我们进行了大量实验，证明MaLoW在OVO-Bench、StreamingBench和StreamArena上取得了强劲性能。在OVO-Bench的后向划分上，MaLoW在不同视频骨干网络上优于先前记忆方法3.9%至11.8%，同时仅带来适度的延迟开销。除流式视频理解外，MaLoW还可泛化至视觉-语言-动作模型，在Simpler WidowX上将动作成功率提升9.3%。

title: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
summary: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/
translation:
标题：SUPRA-TEX：基于超对齐纹理的3D生成

摘要：单图像3D生成旨在为给定3D网格赋予可重光照材质，同时忠实保留参考图像的视觉细节。现有方法要么在融合不一致的多视角预测时引入伪影，要么难以通过隐式图像特征条件化保留精细细节。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了SUPRA-Tex，其遵循将可见材质估计、表面对齐和观测引导的3D补全解耦的原则。这种分工使在有限3D数据上训练的3D生成器能够将其容量集中于保留可见证据并补全未观测表面。具体而言，我们首先训练一个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的图像编辑模型，以在参考视角下预测光照分离的PBR贴图。然后，我们将这些贴图投影到可见表面，并使用预训练的材质VAE编码器将其编码为原生观测潜变量，这些潜变量与生成目标共享同一潜空间。一个交错流Transformer将这些潜变量作为固定的只读锚点，同时交替进行未观测区域更新和全表面更新，以生成完整的材质潜变量。该设计实现了与参考的超对齐，在可见区域提供所见即所得的保真度，并在未观测表面实现连贯补全。仅在公开数据集上训练，SUPRA-Tex在几何条件纹理化和端到端资产生成中均达到SOTA性能，在真实场景图像上匹配甚至超越领先的商业系统。项目主页：https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
summary: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT.
translation:
标题：去中心化智能体集群中的自编排学习

摘要：智能体集群的能力既取决于其个体成员，也取决于它们如何协调。然而，现有多智能体系统通常在固定的编排结构内训练智能体，将个体能力的学习与集体行为的组织割裂开来。我们提出基于市场的后训练（MPT），一个在去中心化智能体集群中联合学习动作策略与自编排的框架。智能体通过出价表达参与意愿，出价决定由谁行动，以及集体结果如何提供局部训练信用。同时学习动作与出价行为，使个体能力和参与模式能够在没有中央协调智能体的情况下共同适应。我们在具身制作、机器人导航和深度研究上评估 MPT。结果表明，相较于单体式后训练，MPT 取得性能提升，并证实智能体参与确实随学习而演化。在相同的后训练动作策略下，学习得到的自编排优于其他协调策略。消融实验表明，动作与出价均受益于学习，并且学习到的出价能提供更有效的动作训练信号。除原始训练目标外，训练后的智能体集群能更快适应相关任务，并在推理时随着群体规模增大取得更优性能。在智能体退出时，较大群体遭受的性能损失也更小，表明学习到的自编排支持去中心化智能体集群的复用、扩展与鲁棒性。代码与训练模型见 https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT。

title: Cowork-Gym: Synthesizing Interactive Work Environments at Scale
summary: Cowork agents navigate dependencies across tools and files while adapting to changing user requirements and edits to shared workspaces. Scaling such environments requires maintaining consistency among task objectives, executable resources, user behavior, and success criteria. We introduce Cowork-Gym, a framework that synthesizes Cowork environments through a build-execute-revise loop that uses execution evidence and review feedback to validate and repair generated environments. To capture realistic Cowork dynamics, a stateful user simulator responds to the agent's actions through dialogue and direct edits to the shared workspace. We synthesize 64.9K environments across 14 application scenarios and use them to post-train 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B Qwen models with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation. Averaged across six agentic benchmarks, these models outperform their corresponding base checkpoints by 8.7, 6.4, and 4.1 points, respectively. Ours-27B ranks second overall among the evaluated models and achieves the highest average scores on PawBench and ClawEval, outperforming models with over 100B total parameters on both benchmarks.
translation:
标题：Cowork-Gym：大规模合成交互式工作环境

摘要：协作智能体在跨工具和文件的依赖关系中运行，同时适应不断变化的用户需求以及对共享工作空间的编辑。扩展此类环境需要在任务目标、可执行资源、用户行为和成功标准之间保持一致性。我们提出了Cowork-Gym，一个通过“构建-执行-修订”循环合成协作环境的框架，该循环利用执行证据和审查反馈来验证和修复生成的环境。为了捕捉真实的协作动态，一个有状态的用户模拟器通过对话和对共享工作空间的直接编辑来响应智能体的动作。我们在14个应用场景中合成了64.9K个环境，并使用这些环境对9B、27B和35B-A3B Qwen模型进行后训练，采用监督微调、强化学习和同策略蒸馏。在六个智能体基准测试中平均而言，这些模型分别比其对应的基础检查点高出8.7、6.4和4.1分。Ours-27B在评估模型中总体排名第二，并在PawBench和ClawEval上取得了最高平均分，在两个基准测试上均优于总参数量超过100B的模型。

title: WorldMemBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Memory of Video World Models
summary: As video models enable longer and more realistic interactive experiences, maintaining a world consistent with its history becomes essential. This requires both preserving previously observed content and ensuring coherent world evolution over time. World memory is a critical capability to evaluate alongside visual fidelity and video duration. We introduce WorldMemBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating world memory in video world models. Across 260 test cases, it assesses static memory through the retention of human identity and appearance, object appearance and geometry, and environmental content and geometry, and dynamic memory through event progression and state persistence. Using controlled camera departures and multi-revisit trajectories, the benchmark evaluates static content against fixed initial references and dynamic events against expected state transitions. It combines appearance and geometry metrics with event-specific assessments, and reports video quality and camera-following accuracy as complementary diagnostics. Evaluation of nine representative models shows that strong static retention does not imply reliable dynamic state evolution, while repeated revisits reveal memory degradation beyond the first return. Human studies support the alignment between our automatic evaluations and human judgments. WorldMemBench provides a systematic testbed for diagnosing memory failures and guiding the development of persistent, temporally coherent video worlds.
translation:
标题：WorldMemBench：视频世界模型记忆的综合基准

摘要：随着视频模型能够实现更长、更真实的交互体验，维持一个与其历史一致的世界变得至关重要。这要求既保留先前观察到的内容，又确保世界随时间连贯演化。世界记忆是一项关键能力，需与视觉保真度和视频时长一同评估。我们提出 WorldMemBench，一个用于系统评估视频世界模型中世界记忆的基准。在 260 个测试用例中，它通过人物身份与外观、物体外观与几何、以及环境内容与几何的保持来评估静态记忆，并通过事件进展与状态持续性来评估动态记忆。该基准利用受控的相机离开和多重重访轨迹，针对固定的初始参考评估静态内容，并针对预期的状态转移评估动态事件。它结合外观与几何指标和事件特定评估，并将视频质量和相机跟随准确性作为补充诊断指标进行报告。对九个代表性模型的评估表明，强静态保持并不意味着可靠的动态状态演化，而重复回访则揭示出首次返回之后的记忆退化。人类研究支持我们的自动评估与人类判断之间的一致性。WorldMemBench 提供了一个系统化测试平台，用于诊断记忆失败并指导持久且时序连贯的视频世界的发展。

title: Virtual Head Attention
summary: The design of attention mechanisms in long-context large language models faces an ``impossible triangle'' among KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality. GQA achieves strong quality but incurs high KV cache overhead; alternative approaches such as MLA and MFA can compress the cache, but MLA suffers from quality loss while MFA substantially increases training and prefill compute. We propose Virtual Head Attention (VHA), which simultaneously improves all three vertices through two lightweight linear operations: Q Premix applies a near-identity transformation to queries within each KV group to recover virtual head diversity from halved physical query heads, and Linear Postmix fuses inter-head features via a low-rank I + AB^top residual structure. Since VHA introduces no nonlinear operations, Premix can be folded into the query projection and Postmix into the output projection at inference time, reducing the model to a standard GQA-2 architecture that directly reuses all existing GQA inference optimizations. With only two KV heads, the group size in large models readily reaches 64, fully exploiting Tensor Core parallelism during decoding. Across four scales with 4K-context 50B-token pretraining, VHA consistently surpasses the standard GQA baseline at every scale (+0.05\% to +0.81\%), while reducing KV cache by 4times vs.\ GQA-8 at dense scales and 2times vs.\ GQA-4 at the MoE scale, and lowering training and prefill FLOPs by 7.9\% (1.7B, S{=}4096). On an industrial 30B-A3B MoE model trained on 500B tokens at 8K context, VHA outperforms both MLA and GQA-4 by +0.70\,/\,+2.60\,\% on a 12-benchmark base-model evaluation suite; in a separate matched 10B-A1B MoE comparison after long-context mid-training, VHA attains an average RULER score of 84.4 over 8K--128K versus 73.0 for GQA, while using two rather than four KV heads in the full-attention layers.
translation:
标题：虚拟头注意力

摘要：长上下文大语言模型中的注意力机制设计面临 KV 缓存大小、训练与预填充 FLOPs 以及模型质量之间的“不可能三角”。GQA 能获得较强质量，但会带来较高的 KV 缓存开销；MLA 和 MFA 等替代方法可以压缩缓存，但 MLA 存在质量损失，而 MFA 会显著增加训练和预填充计算量。我们提出虚拟头注意力（VHA），它通过两种轻量级线性操作同时改善上述三个顶点：Q Premix 对每个 KV 组内的查询应用近恒等变换，以从减半的物理查询头中恢复虚拟头多样性；Linear Postmix 通过低秩 I + AB^T 残差结构融合头间特征。由于 VHA 不引入非线性操作，推理时可将 Premix 折叠进查询投影，将 Postmix 折叠进输出投影，从而将模型归约为标准 GQA-2 架构，直接复用所有现有 GQA 推理优化。仅需两个 KV 头，大模型中的组大小即可轻松达到 64，在解码过程中充分利用 Tensor Core 并行性。在采用 4K 上下文、50B token 预训练的四个规模上，VHA 在每个规模上均持续超越标准 GQA 基线（+0.05% 至 +0.81%），同时在稠密规模下将 KV 缓存较 GQA-8 缩减至 1/4，在 MoE 规模下较 GQA-4 缩减至 1/2，并将训练和预填充 FLOPs 降低 7.9%（1.7B，S=4096）。在一个使用 8K 上下文、500B token 训练的工业级 30B-A3B MoE 模型上，VHA 在 12 项基准的基座模型评估套件上分别比 MLA 和 GQA-4 高出 +0.70% / +2.60%；在另一项经过长上下文中期训练的匹配 10B-A1B MoE 对比中，VHA 在 8K–128K 上的平均 RULER 分数达到 84.4，而 GQA 为 73.0，同时在全注意力层中使用两个而非四个 KV 头。

title: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
summary: Long-context training of large language and multimodal models couples structured attention masks (document, prefix-LM, share-question, sliding-window, block-sparse) with multi-node context parallelism, making the mask a dominant bottleneck. FlashMask's column-wise sparse mask compresses them from O(n^2) to O(n) via four query-axis boundary vectors, covering broad structured patterns. Implemented for Ampere GPUs, it neither exploits FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA warp-specialized pipeline on Hopper nor supports distribution. The column-wise sparse mask is indexed by key positions but stores query-axis interval boundaries. Under any multi-chunk context-parallel assignment, it reduces per-rank mask localization to a provably zero-communication clip--shift--max on the boundary vectors, compatible with the single-GPU kernel. FlashMask-3 introduces a mask-aware Hopper kernel with three-role warp specialization atop FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA pipeline, plus a mask-aware distributed extension: zero-communication mask localization, a sparsity-aware load balancer (HCC-IPO), and a mask-aware compute-communication overlap with mask-driven communication pruning, whose forward all-gather uses topology-aware hierarchical routing. On a single H100 across 12 masks at 4K--128K context, it improves achieved TFLOPs over FlashMask, FlexAttention, and MagiAttention by 45--141%, 34--71%, and 2--44%. At context-parallel degrees 4--32 with 8K sequence per device, it attains 31--75% compute-communication overlap efficiency and improves throughput over Megatron-Core CP ring, Megatron-Core CP all-gather, and MagiAttention by 1.80times--3.71times, 1.71times--2.92times, and 1.09times--1.46times. In end-to-end training of a 118B-A14B MoE at 128K on 128 H100 GPUs, it raises throughput by 7.3--11.0% over a Dual Chunk all-gather baseline, with attention forward+backward 24.5--44.9% faster.
translation:
标题：FlashMask-3：高效且表达力强的掩码感知分布式注意力

摘要：大语言模型和多模态模型的长上下文训练将结构化注意力掩码（文档、prefix-LM、share-question、滑动窗口、块稀疏）与多节点上下文并行耦合在一起，使掩码成为主要瓶颈。FlashMask 的列式稀疏掩码通过四个查询轴边界向量将其从 O(n²) 压缩到 O(n)，覆盖广泛的结构化模式。它针对 Ampere GPU 实现，既未利用 Hopper 上 FlashAttention-3 的 TMA/WGMMA warp 专用化流水线，也不支持分布式。列式稀疏掩码以键位置为索引，但存储查询轴区间边界。在任何多块上下文并行分配下，它都能将每个 rank 的掩码定位简化为对边界向量的可证明零通信 clip–shift–max 操作，并与单 GPU 内核兼容。FlashMask-3 引入了一个掩码感知的 Hopper 内核，在 FlashAttention-3 的 TMA/WGMMA 流水线之上采用三角色 warp 专用化，并加入了掩码感知的分布式扩展：零通信掩码定位、稀疏感知负载均衡器（HCC-IPO），以及带掩码驱动通信剪枝的掩码感知计算-通信重叠，其前向 all-gather 使用拓扑感知的分层路由。在单块 H100 上，在 4K–128K 上下文长度下跨 12 种掩码，其实际达到的 TFLOPs 相比 FlashMask、FlexAttention 和 MagiAttention 分别提升 45%–141%、34%–71% 和 2%–44%。在上下文并行度为 4–32、每设备序列长度为 8K 时，它达到 31%–75% 的计算-通信重叠效率，相比 Megatron-Core CP ring、Megatron-Core CP all-gather 和 MagiAttention，吞吐量达到其 1.80–3.71 倍、1.71–2.92 倍和 1.09–1.46 倍。在 128 块 H100 GPU 上对 118B-A14B MoE 进行 128K 端到端训练时，相较 Dual Chunk all-gather 基线，其吞吐量提升 7.3%–11.0%，注意力前向+反向速度提升 24.5%–44.9%。

title: Calibrated Typed Decisions for Entity, Relation, and Event Extraction
summary: Information extraction models often perform well on the datasets they are trained on, but transferring to new domains and annotation guidelines remains challenging. Supporting user-specified types alone does not resolve this problem. We present CalOn, a unified 0.6B-parameter encoder for entity, relation, and event extraction across datasets and schemas. The model jointly encodes text and type definitions, then directly identifies entity spans, relations between spans, and event triggers and arguments. Its extraction decisions consider the requested types together, using their combined evidence to identify relevant candidates before assigning a type. This gives all three tasks a common probabilistic formulation while keeping every extracted mention anchored to the input text. We train on diverse sources, and supplement supervised learning with a reward that encourages correct extractions and penalises incorrect ones. Across 40 benchmarks, CalOn outperforms the evaluated baselines on most benchmarks. It leads all reported relation extraction benchmarks and achieves the highest average F1 for event triggers and arguments with gold triggers. The same model also performs strongly on aspect sentiment triplet extraction and pronoun resolution through its span-pair formulation. A correction for the probability bias introduced during training improves confidence estimates for entities, relations, and event arguments after calibration, with little change in F1.
translation:
标题：面向实体、关系与事件抽取的校准类型化决策

摘要：信息抽取模型通常在其训练数据集上表现良好，但迁移到新领域和标注指南仍具挑战性。仅支持用户指定类型本身并不能解决这一问题。我们提出 CalOn，一个统一的 0.6B 参数编码器，用于跨数据集和模式的实体、关系与事件抽取。该模型联合编码文本和类型定义，然后直接识别实体跨度、跨度间关系以及事件触发词和论元。其抽取决策会共同考虑所请求的类型，利用它们的组合证据在分配类型之前识别相关候选。这为所有三项任务提供了统一的概率形式，同时使每个抽取到的提及都锚定于输入文本。我们在多样化来源上训练，并用奖励补充监督学习，该奖励鼓励正确抽取并惩罚错误抽取。在 40 个基准上，CalOn 在大多数基准上优于所评估的基线。它在所有已报告的关系抽取基准上领先，并在使用金标触发词的情况下，于事件触发词和论元上取得最高平均 F1。同一模型还通过其跨度对形式，在方面情感三元组抽取和代词消解上表现强劲。对训练期间引入的概率偏差进行校正，可在校准后改善实体、关系和事件论元的置信度估计，而 F1 变化很小。

title: SERO: Learning from Executable Oracle Continuations for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon agentic RL is constrained by the futures visited by the current policy. When rollouts fail to reach useful behaviors, improved credit assignment cannot provide supervision for states and actions that were never encountered. On-policy distillation (OPD) introduces teacher guidance on policy-induced states, and recent multi-turn variants improve how this guidance is scheduled, replayed, refined, or validated. However, they do not directly use the oracle-controlled future itself as the training trajectory. We introduce State-Rooted Executable Rollout Optimization (SERO), which augments on-policy agentic RL with executable oracle continuations. SERO restores a state actually reached by the current policy and lets a training-only oracle continue interacting with the real environment, making the downstream observations and oracle actions themselves available for learning. It then applies policy-reachability weighting, which weights each oracle step by the frozen behavior policy's compatibility with the preceding oracle actions. This allows deeper supervision to become effective as the policy becomes more compatible with the oracle branch. The oracle loss is optimized separately from the base RL estimator and no oracle is used at inference time. We evaluate SERO on two challenging interactive-agent benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop, using Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. On ALFWorld, learning the full executable continuation is substantially more effective than supervising only the root oracle action, while policy-reachability weighting further improves out-of-distribution performance.
translation:
标题：SERO：面向长时程智能体强化学习，从可执行预言机延续中学习

摘要：长时程智能体强化学习受限于当前策略所访问的未来轨迹。当展开轨迹未能到达有用行为时，即使改进信用分配，也无法为从未遇到的状态和动作提供监督。同策略蒸馏（OPD）在策略诱导的状态上引入教师指导，而近期的多轮变体改进了该指导的调度、重放、精炼或验证方式。然而，它们并未直接将由预言机控制的未来本身用作训练轨迹。我们提出状态根植的可执行展开优化（SERO），它通过可执行预言机延续增强同策略智能体强化学习。SERO 恢复当前策略实际到达的某个状态，并让仅在训练时使用的预言机继续与真实环境交互，从而使下游观测和预言机动作本身可用于学习。随后，它应用策略可达性加权，根据冻结行为策略与前序预言机动作的兼容性对每个预言机步骤进行加权。随着策略与预言机分支变得更加兼容，这使更深入的监督得以生效。预言机损失与基础 RL 估计器分开优化，且推理时不使用预言机。我们在两个具有挑战性的交互式智能体基准 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 评估 SERO。在 ALFWorld 上，学习完整的可执行延续比仅监督根预言机动作显著更有效，而策略可达性加权进一步提升了分布外性能。

title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
summary: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.
translation:
标题：CoDA：数据引擎与动作策略的协同演化

摘要：生成式仿真能够自动化机器人环境构建，但物理有效的环境未必对训练有用。其挑战在于识别能够应对策略失败的环境，以及帮助策略克服这些失败的监督。我们提出 CoDA 框架，其中仿真数据引擎与动作策略通过一个共享的异构记忆协同演化，该记忆涵盖环境构建、策略失败与学习进展。该记忆将来自视觉-语言评判器的经验证诊断编译为生成程序与训练程序，前者重现困难，后者帮助策略克服这些困难。我们进一步提出 Text2potential，将这些诊断转化为用于动作块价值学习的分阶段势函数，在为策略更新提供稠密监督的同时，在标准塑形假设下保持任务的最优策略。可度量的学习进展指导进一步的生成与程序细化。在四个操作任务族中，CoDA 将分布外成功率从监督微调后的 5.3% 提升至 27.6%，在相同生成预算下以 9.5 个百分点超过最强闭环基线。在 LIBERO-Pro 上，15 轮生成与训练将位置扰动下的成功率从 25% 提升至 84%，并将指令扰动下的成功率从 1% 提升至 76%。

title: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
summary: Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with O(d log d) compute for projection and reconstruction and O(d) memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. We further introduce an efficient table-free lexicographic coding scheme that makes combinatorial encoding practical at larger dimensions. Beyond images, we adapt the framework to an autoregressive video flow model and develop a streaming compression scheme that periodically re-encodes recently reconstructed frames into a fresh KV-cache prefix, preserving temporal context across segments at no additional transmitted bits. This enables long-form, close to real-time generative video compression on a single GPU. Across image and video benchmarks, H-DDCM achieves competitive rate-distortion-perception performance while substantially reducing the memory and computational overhead of codebook-based training-free generative compression.
translation:
标题：H-DDCM：用于快速生成式图像与视频压缩的哈达玛码本

摘要：免训练的基于扩散的压缩方法重新利用扩散模型或流模型的生成先验来压缩数据，而无需将其重新训练为任务专用编解码器。近期基于码本的方法（如 Turbo-DDCM）在超低比特率下取得了较强的感知质量，但其对稠密高斯码本的依赖在内存和计算上仍代价高昂，并且随着现代图像和视频生成器的潜空间维度增大，其扩展性较差。其组合比特流编码在这一规模下也会变得计算繁重。我们提出 H-DDCM，一种可扩展的生成式压缩框架，用隐式随机化哈达玛字典替代高斯码本。快速沃尔什-哈达玛变换能够以用于投影和重建的 O(d log d) 计算量以及 O(d) 内存隐式合成全维字典，而无需实际构造全维字典。我们进一步提出一种高效的无查表字典序编码方案，使组合编码在更大维度下变得实用。除图像外，我们将该框架适配至自回归视频流模型，并开发了一种流式压缩方案，该方案周期性地将最近重建的帧重新编码为新的 KV 缓存前缀，从而在不增加额外传输比特的情况下跨片段保留时序上下文。这使得在单块 GPU 上实现长时长、接近实时的生成式视频压缩成为可能。在图像和视频基准测试中，H-DDCM 取得了具有竞争力的率-失真-感知性能，同时显著降低了基于码本的免训练生成式压缩的内存和计算开销。
